seo.description: Swimwear manufacturer with its own Guangzhou factory: OEM, ODM and private label swimwear from 50 pieces per style and colour, samples in 10–15 days.

hero.heading: Swimwear Made for Your Brand, Start to Finish
lead: Strandmill is a swimwear manufacturer in Guangzhou, making OEM and ODM collections for business buyers.

cta.label: Request a quote

blocks.heading: Our Own Swimwear Factory in China
paragraphs: We make your swimwear in our own single factory in Guangzhou, Guangdong, China. Production and export sit within one company, so quality, cost and delivery stay under our direct control.

[Our factory has been running since 2011](/about-us/). We check quality throughout each order and sell B2B only, through this website and our team. You agree every order directly with us, never through online shops or third-party marketplaces.

[Our production certifications](/sustainability/) include OEKO-TEX Standard 100 for tested fabrics and trims, GRS and RCS for recycled fabrics, bluesign for chemistry, ISO 9001 for quality management and WRAP for social compliance.

blocks.heading: Why Brands Source From Our Own Factory

items.heading: Independent inspection
items.text: You're welcome to book [pre-shipment inspections](/faq/) with independent inspectors such as SGS or BV before your goods leave our factory.

items.heading: Bulk production timing
items.text: Once you approve the sample and we receive your deposit, [bulk production takes 35 to 40 days](/faq/). Your order size and the season set the exact timing.

items.heading: Sample courier cost
items.text: [Courier delivery for samples costs USD 50](/faq/), and you pay it on top of the sample fee.

items.heading: Direct enquiry response
items.text: When you [contact our team](/contact-us/), you get a reply to every enquiry within one business day.

blocks.heading: Custom Swimwear in Every Style and Size

items.heading: Women's collections
paragraphs: We make women's swimwear in contemporary and classic shapes, seamless styles included, in plain or printed fabrics chosen for your collection.

items.heading: Men's swimwear
paragraphs: We make men's swim briefs, board shorts and swim trunks in durable, quick-drying fabrics, with modern cuts, functional waistbands and secure stitching. You choose the specifications and can ask for sample adjustments before production starts.

items.heading: Children's collections
paragraphs: Our dedicated children's lines run from babies to older children and include shorts, sets and boys' pieces with rubber patch labels. We handle everything from printing to finishing, using soft fabrics, smooth stitching and strong seams, and we test samples for stretch and durability.

items.heading: Matching family sets
paragraphs: We cut matching adult and children's pieces from a single print run, and we agree the fabric quantities for every size group beforehand. Separate runs cause shade and alignment differences that show when the pieces are worn side by side.

items.heading: Coordinated couples' swimwear
paragraphs: We also make paired swimwear for couples, building coordinated looks around the fabric, print and style specifications you choose.

items.heading: Beach cover-ups
paragraphs: We make cover-ups, sarongs, pareos and kaftans to go with your swimwear, in the silhouettes, fabrics, prints and trims you pick.

items.heading: Resort clothing and accessories
paragraphs: You can add headbands, dresses, blouses, tops, skirts and pants to your range. We make them alongside the swimwear, so you get a complete resort collection.

items.heading: Crochet and knits
paragraphs: For beachwear collections, we also make hand-made crochet pieces and space-dyed knits in 100% cotton.

blocks.heading: Custom Swimwear in Every Cut, Fabric and Finish
paragraphs: You can choose from triangle, bandeau, halter and underwire bikinis, tankinis and monokinis, through to [burkinis](/burkini-manufacturer/) and high-cut one-pieces.

items.heading: Custom fit and construction
paragraphs: We build made-to-order styles on your patterns and customise the silhouettes, panels, coverage, colours, prints, embroidery, hardware, cups and performance features. During sampling we refine bikini straps, linings and closures, along with the stretch, support and shape retention of one-pieces.

items.heading: Plus-size and larger cups
paragraphs: We fit these samples on a body in the target size. Cup depth, strap angle and coverage all change between sizes, so scaling alone leads to gaping, digging or too little support. The extra sampling round adds time before bulk production.

items.heading: Tankini and bandeau fit
paragraphs: We develop tankini tops that pair with several bottoms and choose the coverage, breathability and stretch. For bandeaus, extra-stretch fabrics, the right linings and sample adjustments give a secure, comfortable grip.

items.heading: Long-sleeve and performance styles
paragraphs: We check long-sleeve samples for stretch, use UPF-rated fabric and keep plus-size proportions balanced. Performance styles use compression, resistance and speed-focused fabrics, hydrodynamic patterns and reinforced seams, and we test the samples for performance accuracy.

items.heading: Fabric sourcing options
paragraphs: Our [fabric sourcing](/swimwear-fabrics-sourcing/) includes nylon/polyester-spandex blends, such as 80% nylon 20% spandex, with matching linings. Chlorine-resistant LYCRA Xtra Life, ECONYL recycled nylon, REPREVE recycled polyester and Italian Carvico are available on request.

items.heading: Custom Printing service
paragraphs: Our [Custom Printing service](/custom-swimwear-printing/) prints polyester and sun-protection fabrics on our factory's thermal sublimation printer before cutting, so printing and manufacturing happen in the same place.

items.heading: Embroidery service limits
paragraphs: Our [Embroidery service](/swimwear-embroidery/) offers standard machine or hand embroidery plus 3D, reflective and stone finishes. Embroidery and screen printing need 50 pieces per design, thread colours come from the available libraries, and custom woven labels need 1,000 pieces.

items.heading: Swimwear Hardware service
paragraphs: Our [Swimwear Hardware service](/swimwear-hardware/) supplies colour-matched straps, rings, sliders, hooks and buckles in metal, plastic, resin or eco-friendly materials, along with drawstrings, eyelets and zippers.

blocks.heading: OEM Swimwear From Your Design, ODM From Ours

items.heading: Development service
paragraphs: Our [Development service](/development/) turns your concepts into production-ready samples in 10 to 15 days. Grading from XS to 3XL is free, and we grade against US, EU or UK charts, your own fit references, or charts we develop for your market.

items.heading: OEM production
paragraphs: If you already have tested patterns and a tech pack, OEM is your route. We produce to your existing specifications and check every stage against them.

items.heading: ODM design development
paragraphs: If you have a brand concept but no developed designs yet, ODM is your route. It includes the design development needed to create exclusive styles for your brand.

items.heading: In-house design team
paragraphs: You can start with a design, a picture or just an idea. Our team handles the patterns, grading and fit development, which means less design back-and-forth for you.

blocks.heading: Private Label Swimwear, Branded and Packed as Yours

items.heading: Private label collections
paragraphs: Our private label service covers both existing and custom designs. Your branding goes on the finished garments, and ours never does.

items.heading: Collection customisation
paragraphs: You decide the fit, construction, materials, features, finishes and size ranges. We help you select fabrics, match colours and develop silhouettes for your label.

items.heading: Logo positioning
paragraphs: You choose where your logo goes. We confirm the label type and position during sampling, before we make your branded collection.

items.heading: Labels against wet skin
paragraphs: A woven neck label rubs against wet skin and pulls at thin necklines. A tagless heat-transfer label sits flat, and you can't feel it.

items.heading: Individual branded packing
paragraphs: We mark and pack each piece individually in custom packaging built around your logo. We work directly with you all the way through worldwide delivery.

items.heading: Packaging and labels service
paragraphs: Our [Swimwear Packaging & Custom Brand Labels service](/swimwear-packaging-custom-brand-labels/) includes a heat-transfer label, a hygiene liner and a hang tag, carrying your inside-back logo, washing instructions and size information. You can also add branded clips, silicone logos and fabric tags.

items.heading: Launch service packages
paragraphs: The starter pack in our [Launch service](/swimwear-launch-services/) contains three finished samples, twenty fabric swatches, a stock-style catalogue and a launch guide. We also offer separate packages for designing, developing and manufacturing your first collection, as well as consulting.

blocks.heading: From Brief to Sample to Shipment

items.heading: Free quotation
paragraphs: For a [free quote](/request-a-quote/), email or WhatsApp us your tech pack or design, or coded front and back drawings or screenshots. Include your fabrics, colours, prints, quantities, sizing and packing needs. We assess feasibility and quote you an estimated price and timing. Then we agree the specifications, minimums and availability with you before you order.

items.heading: Brief and specifications
paragraphs: We go through your brief with you in a consultation and confirm the technical requirements, including fabric and stretch. Then we send you digital mockups to approve.

items.heading: Sampling before commitment
paragraphs: We source and prepare the materials, then revise and fit-test development samples. That way you can judge the product before you commit to bulk manufacturing.

items.heading: Written fit approval
paragraphs: We don't cut any bulk fabric until you approve the final fit sample in writing. Changes made after cutting waste fabric and delay the schedule.

items.heading: Production and finishing
paragraphs: We manage cutting, sewing and assembly, followed by washing and functional finishing. We also handle sourcing and inspections for you for the whole order.

items.heading: Shipment and support
paragraphs: Once your goods pass inspection, we pack them and store them until they ship. After that, our team is still available for after-sales support.

blocks.heading: Start at 50 Pieces: MOQ, Fees and Terms

items.heading: Minimum order quantity
paragraphs: Orders start at 50 pieces per style in each colour, so small and growing labels can place production orders. Those 50 pieces are split over 3 to 4 sizes. A bikini top sold with its bottom counts as one piece, while tops and bottoms sold separately are counted separately.

items.heading: First trial runs
paragraphs: We agree first-trial quantities case by case. How flexible we can be on quantity depends on what production allows for your order.

items.heading: Sample and design fees
paragraphs: Each sample costs USD 50. Design costs USD 50 per design, meaning per pattern or print, with all its colourways included. Neither fee is refunded or credited against bulk orders.

items.heading: Payment schedule
paragraphs: You pay a 50% deposit when you confirm the order. The remaining 50% is due before your goods ship.

items.heading: Shipping terms
paragraphs: We ship FOB, CIF or DDP. With worldwide DDP you get one all-in price for delivery to your door, and we handle freight, customs and duties through our forwarding partners.

items.heading: Quality problem resolution
paragraphs: Under our [quality terms](/terms-and-conditions/), report any defects within 7 days of receiving your goods and send photos or videos. Once we've assessed them, we repair, remake, replace or credit the affected pieces. Shipping and handling are not refunded.

blocks.heading: Wholesale Swimwear, Ready to Brand and Ship
paragraphs: Our ready-to-brand wholesale swimwear is already designed, patterned and graded to international body sizes. That cuts your development cost and your fit risk for a first collection. You can build your main range from these styles and add custom shapes as your signature pieces.

The collections cover women, men, children and plus sizes, with full, medium or cheeky bottom coverage, and we update the designs each season. You pick the styles, fabrics and colours. We produce them under your brand with your own custom heat-pressed logo.

If you choose designs we've already developed, you skip sampling and place a bulk PO in the colours and prints you want. Production starts once you approve the digital proof in writing. There's no physical sample, so that proof is your last chance to catch errors before manufacturing. Check the print scale, placement and colour on it carefully.
In-stock styles leave our warehouse within 24 hours, or within 7 business days at the latest. Email us to see more of the models and colours we have available.

We keep steady stock of selected wholesale styles, so you can place repeat orders. Ask us for our design catalogue. Once you've sent your enquiry, we send you line sheets with the available styles and their wholesale prices.

We arrange stock samples within 1 to 2 business days. Order one before you decide between screen printing, heat transfers, embroidery or fabric logo labels, so you match the technique to the actual fabric. The fabric's texture and stretch affect how the finish looks and how long it lasts.

Frequently Asked Questions

items.question: Which kinds of swimwear do you make, such as bikinis, one-pieces, swim shorts and cover-ups, and is it for women, men and children?
items.answer: Yes, we make swimwear for women, men and children. That covers bikinis, tankinis, one-pieces, monokinis, rash guards, swim shorts, board shorts and swim briefs, as well as sarongs, kaftans and beach dresses. We work from your designs or from our existing styles, in sizes XS to 3XL (S to 3XL for men's and modest styles), and up to 5XL for plus sizes.

items.question: How do you check the fit and finish of each order before it ships?
items.answer: Before bulk production, we refine and fit-test your samples. After that we check the incoming fabric, the cutting and the sewing, run random checks during production and finish with a full final inspection. Before packing, we check the components against the sample you approved.

items.question: Can you handle the whole job, including fabric sourcing, trims, labels and packaging, or do we have to supply some of it?
items.answer: One team runs the whole job, from fabric sourcing, hardware and accessories to labels, packaging and export shipping, and every production stage stays in our own factory. You don't have to supply any of these components. Because we check them all together against your approved sample, there are fewer handoffs between suppliers and less risk of mismatched trims, wrong labels or packing errors.

seo.description: Women's swimwear manufacturer for bikinis, one-pieces and tankinis: cup grading to G, long-torso and tummy-control fits, recycled fabrics, from 50 pieces.

hero.heading: Private Label Women's Swimwear Manufacturer for Every Body Type
lead: We shape each style around real bodies, with support placed where your customers need it.

cta.label: Request a quote for women's swimwear

blocks.heading: Bikinis, One-Pieces and Tankinis From Our Factory in Guangzhou, China
paragraphs: We make your women’s swimwear ourselves, in our single factory in Guangzhou, Guangdong, China. That includes bikinis in a wide choice of cuts and colours, one-pieces, tankinis, performance athletic swimsuits and long-sleeve styles designed for sun protection.

We’ve run our [factory and export business](/about-us/) since 2011, so quality, cost and delivery stay under our direct control. We check quality all the way through each order. We agree every B2B order directly with you through our website and team, never through online or third-party shops.

blocks.heading: Inclusive Fits for Every Body: Extended Sizes, Cup Grading and Long Torsos

items.heading: Extended sizing
paragraphs: For your collection, we make large-bust OEM/ODM swimwear in a range of colours, in sizes XS to 3XL, or up to 5XL in our plus-size range.

items.heading: Band-and-cup grading
paragraphs: We grade tops to your own size chart, for example 32D to 38G. Our structured underwire tops cover D to DD+ and go up to G cup.

items.heading: Size allocation
paragraphs: Each band-and-cup combination counts as one size. A wider cup range splits your order across more sizes and needs more fit approvals than letter sizing does.

items.heading: Dedicated fit blocks
paragraphs: Stretching one letter-size pattern across different bust and torso shapes leaves cups gaping and straps digging in. We use band-and-cup grading and dedicated torso lengths instead.

items.heading: Long-torso adjustment
paragraphs: You can have long-torso grading on every one-piece and tankini. It adds roughly 5 cm in total above and below the waist, and the bust and leg lines stay where they are.

items.heading: Measurements to send
paragraphs: Send us your customer’s bust, waist, hip, height and torso girth. If the girth is more than 4 cm over our chart, we switch to the long-torso block.

items.heading: Measuring torso girth
paragraphs: Stand straight. Run the tape from one shoulder down the front, between the legs and up the back to where it started, keeping it snug against bare skin or a thin layer.

items.heading: Detail-specific samples
paragraphs: Any style with cut-outs, cross-back straps or placed prints gets its own fit sample, so those details stay in the right place.

blocks.heading: Tummy Control, Body Shaping and Maternity Cuts

items.heading: Shaping construction
paragraphs: Our wholesale tummy-control one-pieces and bikinis, high-waisted cuts included, use power mesh front panels, double front linings or full compression bodies, either alone or combined.

items.heading: Control levels
paragraphs: You choose the level: light control with 160 GSM mesh, medium with a 200 GSM panel, or firm with a 240 GSM panel plus a double lining.

items.heading: Control by use
paragraphs: We use firm compression for structured shaping one-pieces and lighter control for everyday styles and high-waisted bottoms. If a shaping piece has too little compression, it won’t give the smoothing it was designed for.

items.heading: Compression trade-offs
paragraphs: Too much compression makes comfort styles hard to put on and uncomfortable to wear all day. Firmer control also adds layers, warmth, drying time and manufacturing cost.

items.heading: Maternity silhouettes
paragraphs: We develop maternity one-pieces, tankinis and bikinis. They have high-waisted bottoms that sit above or below the bump, ruched side panels that expand, and fronts cut 4 to 6 cm longer.

items.heading: Bust and nursing support
paragraphs: Shelf bras or soft cups provide maternity support. For nursing, we add pull-aside or clip-down cups to your design.

items.heading: Maternity one-piece comfort
paragraphs: Our maternity one-pieces have adjustable straps and a full soft lining, and they’re made without underwire.

items.heading: Contoured shaping
paragraphs: In our [Plus Size Swimwear](/plus-size-swimwear-manufacturer/) range, we shape the silhouette for your collection with contoured seam lines.

blocks.heading: Performance Features Built for Comfort, Support and Durability

items.heading: Functional options
items.text: We add UPF 50+ sun protection, underwire support, quick-dry fabric and chlorine-resistant stitching to match your swimwear specification.

items.heading: Construction compatibility
items.text: Underwire needs the right channel and padding. Chlorine-resistant stitching needs chlorine-resistant elastic underneath it, or the construction won’t stand up to chlorine.

items.heading: Sample confirmation
items.text: We confirm all the features together on your fit sample, checking the padding system, sewing method and adjustable straps for fit and comfort.

items.heading: Development trade-offs
items.text: Each feature you add brings more materials to check and test, so it raises the cost and adds sampling time for those checks.

blocks.heading: Premium and Recycled Fabrics With Water-Based Digital Prints
paragraphs: We cut custom bikinis and one-pieces from premium fabrics. For sustainable lines, we pair recycled nylon with water-based digital printing.

items.heading: Actual-fabric approval
paragraphs: Before bulk production, we get your approval on a printed strike-off. Recycled and virgin bases take ink differently, so the actual fabric is what sets the colour and sharpness.

items.heading: Cost and timing
paragraphs: Recycled fabric and strike-off approval cost more and take longer than stock fabric and screen-printed colours.

items.heading: Fabric sourcing
paragraphs: Our [Swimwear Fabrics & Sourcing service](/swimwear-fabrics-sourcing/) supplies lined nylon/polyester-spandex options, including 80% nylon 20% spandex. Branded or recycled fabrics, textures, metallic yarns and custom dyeing are each quoted as a separate premium. Italian fabric carries the largest premium when you order below a full minimum run.

items.heading: Production credentials
paragraphs: Our [sustainability credentials](/sustainability/) cover OEKO-TEX Standard 100 for tested fabrics and trims, GRS and RCS for recycled fabrics, bluesign for chemistry, ISO 9001 for quality management and WRAP for social compliance.

items.heading: Custom print development
paragraphs: Our [Custom Printing service](/custom-swimwear-printing/) gives you chlorine-resistant, high-resolution sublimation, digital printing and nearly any colour or print that can be sourced. Exclusive patterns add cost and lead time.

blocks.heading: Custom Swimwear Embellishment: Rhinestones, Beads and Trims

items.heading: Decoration placement
paragraphs: We place rhinestones, handcrafted beading and built-in hardware away from spots where they would rub skin or catch on fabric. Dense hand-beading is kept for statement styles.

items.heading: Design-specific pricing
paragraphs: Embellishment raises the unit price and the lead time. We quote each design on its stone count, beading density and choice of hardware, and we put most of the decoration on styles where looks come first.

items.heading: Custom bead minimums
paragraphs: Custom-moulded, colour-matched beads start at 1,000 pieces per design and colour. This minimum is separate from the garment order minimum.

items.heading: Hand-beading schedule
paragraphs: Hand-beading adds 1 to 2 weeks to bulk production. Denser work takes longer.

items.heading: Hand-finished care
paragraphs: Hand-finished pieces need gentler care, so we recommend them for resort and statement styles rather than active swimming.

items.heading: Branded metal hardware
paragraphs: Our [Swimwear Hardware service](/swimwear-hardware/) supplies branded metal components that resist saltwater and chlorine. Standard hardware starts at 100 to 500 pieces per colour or size. Logo or embossed stoppers, clasps, hooks, sliders and rings start at 1,000 pieces per item.

blocks.heading: Private Label Design, Sampling and Your Own Supplied Materials
rows: We support OEM/ODM bikinis, one-pieces and athletic styles. Our [Development team](/development/) takes your design, picture or idea through in-house pattern design, grading and fit development.

A standard sample costs USD 50 and is ready in 10 to 15 days. The design fee is USD 50 per design and covers its pattern or print in all colourways. Neither fee is refunded or credited against bulk orders.
On top of the sample fee, you pay USD 50 for [sample courier delivery](/faq/).

Send a nylon- or polyester-spandex blend, such as our 180–200 GSM 80/20 nylon-spandex, with its composition, weight and stretch data. We test it for shrinkage, colour fastness and stretch before we cut.
We accept your own fabric, cups, elastic and other trims. Cups and elastic must be swim-grade and chlorine-resistant. We check 2 pieces of each on your sample first.
Testing adds a step before production. If a material fails, you have to replace it and the schedule slips. Testing before cutting keeps shrinkage, bleeding or weak stretch from reaching a cut lot.

Our customisable [Launch service](/swimwear-launch-services/) takes your bikinis and one-pieces from consultation, design, tech packs, patterns, sourcing and sampling all the way through bulk manufacture, branding, packaging, worldwide shipping and after-sales support.

Our [Swimwear Packaging & Custom Brand Labels service](/swimwear-packaging-custom-brand-labels/) provides industrially compostable packaging, branded accessories and a heat-pressed logo inside garments. Connected cardboard tags and individual hand-wrapping are optional. We source labels and packaging through our trim suppliers.

Frequently Asked Questions

items.question: Can you grade women's plus-size swimwear above 3XL, and up to what size and cup size?
items.answer: Yes. Our standard grading runs from XS to 3XL, and our Plus Size Swimwear range goes past that, up to 5XL. Our structured underwire tops go up to G cup.

items.question: How do you stop removable cups from moving or folding inside the suit after washing?
items.answer: We cut the cup pockets to the exact shape of the cup and give them side openings with a 1 cm overlap. The cup edges are rounded and tapered, so they sit flat against the lining. If you ask, we add a stitched tack point or a small hook-and-loop tab at the base of each pocket. We then wash the sample 5 times to confirm the cups stay flat and don't shift or fold.

items.question: Which outer-fabric and lining combinations do you use to keep white and pale swimwear opaque when wet and stretched?
items.answer: We pair a dense 190 to 220 GSM warp-knit tricot shell with a self-fabric double layer, a 140 GSM stretch tricot lining or a lined front panel. Being opaque when dry doesn't prove a fabric covers when it's wet. That's why we check your sample wet and stretched, along with the removable-cup wash test.

mainEntity.name: Can you grade women's plus-size swimwear above 3XL, and up to what size and cup size?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Our standard grading runs from XS to 3XL, and our Plus Size Swimwear range goes past that, up to 5XL. Our structured underwire tops go up to G cup.

mainEntity.name: How do you stop removable cups from moving or folding inside the suit after washing?

acceptedAnswer.text: We cut the cup pockets to the exact shape of the cup and give them side openings with a 1 cm overlap. The cup edges are rounded and tapered, so they sit flat against the lining. If you ask, we add a stitched tack point or a small hook-and-loop tab at the base of each pocket. We then wash the sample 5 times to confirm the cups stay flat and don't shift or fold.

mainEntity.name: Which outer-fabric and lining combinations do you use to keep white and pale swimwear opaque when wet and stretched?

acceptedAnswer.text: We pair a dense 190 to 220 GSM warp-knit tricot shell with a self-fabric double layer, a 140 GSM stretch tricot lining or a lined front panel. Being opaque when dry doesn't prove a fabric covers when it's wet. That's why we check your sample wet and stretched, along with the removable-cup wash test.

blocks.heading: OEM One-Piece Swimsuits and ODM Programmes
paragraphs: We build custom one-piece swimsuits for you in two ways. OEM programmes are made from your own designs, and ODM programmes are developed from our styles. Whether you start from your design or one of ours, your range can include monokinis and cut-out designs.

blocks.heading: One-Piece Styles From Our Block Library
paragraphs: For ODM styles, we start from the library block closest to your target market and adapt it.

items.heading: Classic maillot
paragraphs: You can start from our classic one-piece block, which has a clean square or scoop neckline.

items.heading: Sculpting monokini
paragraphs: This sculpting silhouette has cut-outs shaped at the side or front and joined with connecting hardware.

items.heading: One-shoulder silhouette
paragraphs: We develop asymmetric one-shoulder styles for your range, finished with either a single strap or a ruffle detail.

items.heading: Deep-V plunge
paragraphs: An internal power-mesh layer holds the deep-V plunge silhouette and supports the shape of the suit.

items.heading: Surf and active styles
paragraphs: For surf and modest-leaning markets, we offer long-sleeve swim tops and zip-front styles. We also offer sport-cut racerbacks with wide straps and more back coverage.

items.heading: Specialist fit ranges
paragraphs: Our [women’s swimwear range](/women-s-swimwear-manufacturer/) includes wholesale tummy-control styles and maternity fronts cut 4 to 6 cm longer. It also includes long-torso fits that add roughly 5 cm when torso girth exceeds our chart by more than 4 cm.

items.text: We make your swimwear ourselves, in our single factory in Guangzhou, Guangdong, China.

items.heading: Direct factory control

items.heading: Inspection and sample delivery
items.text: Under our [inspection and sample arrangements](/faq/), you're welcome to bring in SGS or BV before shipment. Courier delivery of samples costs you USD 50, which is charged separately from sample fees.

items.heading: Production credentials
items.text: Our [production certifications](/sustainability/) cover OEKO-TEX Standard 100 for tested fabrics and trims, GRS/RCS for recycled fabrics, bluesign chemistry, ISO 9001 quality management and WRAP social compliance.

items.heading: Full-package Launch service
items.text: Our [Launch service](/swimwear-launch-services/) takes your custom one-pieces all the way from consultation and development through sampling, production, branding, quality control, packaging, worldwide shipping and after-sales support.

items.heading: Labels and branding
items.text: With our [Swimwear Packaging & Custom Brand Labels service](/swimwear-packaging-custom-brand-labels/), your branding goes in during manufacture. Options are tagless heat transfers, recycled woven or printed labels, and logo printing after sewing.

items.heading: Embroidery service minimums
items.text: Our [Embroidery service](/swimwear-embroidery/) needs 50 pieces per design for embroidery or screen printing and 1,000 pieces for custom woven labels. Thread colours come from the available libraries.

blocks.heading: Private Label One-Piece Orders: MOQ, Samples, Lead Times and Payment

items.heading: Order quantities
paragraphs: Orders start at 50 pieces per style in each colour. For a first trial, we agree the quantity with you case by case, within production limits.

items.heading: Samples and design fees
paragraphs: A standard sample takes 10 to 15 days and costs USD 50. Design costs USD 50 per pattern or print and covers all colourways. Neither fee is refunded or credited against bulk.

items.heading: Bulk production timing
paragraphs: Once you approve the sample and we receive your deposit, bulk production takes 35 to 40 days, depending on order size and season.

items.heading: Payment schedule
paragraphs: You pay a 50% deposit when we confirm your order and the remaining 50% before shipment.

items.heading: Shipping terms
paragraphs: We ship FOB, CIF or DDP. Worldwide DDP gives you one all-in price delivered to your door, and we handle duties, customs and freight through our forwarding partners.

items.heading: Development and fit approval
paragraphs: Our [Development service](/development/) handles patterns and grading in-house. We revise samples based on your feedback, sign off fit against the measurements and check every graded size before production.

items.heading: Quotation before sampling
paragraphs: Through our [quotation process](/request-a-quote/), you get detailed costs from sampling to shipping within 2 to 3 working days of sending us complete front-and-back images, tech packs or clear drawings. Sampling starts once we agree on the price.

items.heading: Enquiry response time
paragraphs: We [reply to every enquiry](/contact-us/) within one business day, whether you're discussing a trial run or your next production order.

blocks.heading: Custom One-Piece Design Options: Neckline, Back, Leg Line and Cut-Outs
paragraphs: You can customise every design, print, colour, cut and detail of your one-piece. We choose the neckline, back and leg line together so the support stays balanced.

items.heading: Neckline and back
items.text: Pick a scoop, square, plunge, halter, one-shoulder or high-neck neckline and pair it with an open, cross-back, racerback, zip-back or low-back design.

items.heading: Leg line choices
items.text: Your one-piece range can use classic, high-cut, French-cut or sport leg lines.

items.heading: Reinforced cut-outs
items.text: Cut-outs go at the side, front or underbust, and we reinforce every stress point with bar tacks.

items.heading: Mixed fabric panels
items.text: When the fabrics have similar stretch, we combine power mesh, rib or crinkle knits and compression fabric up to 220 gsm. This includes mesh insets, or textured fronts with compression backs.

items.heading: Different stretch levels
items.text: When two fabrics differ in stretch by more than 15%, we back the softer panel with body lining, sew the joins with stretch coverstitching and fit-sample the seams before bulk.

items.heading: Custom Printing service
items.text: Our [Custom Printing service](/custom-swimwear-printing/) maps your motifs across the pattern pieces. Tight curves and high-stretch areas shift the alignment, so we check fitted samples and keep key motifs away from tight curves.

blocks.heading: Shaping Fabrics, Linings and Performance Options

items.heading: Base fabric and sourcing
paragraphs: Our default is 80% nylon 20% spandex with a matching lining. Through our [fabric sourcing](/swimwear-fabrics-sourcing/), you can also ask for polyester blends, chlorine-resistant LYCRA Xtra Life, recycled ECONYL nylon, REPREVE polyester and Italian Carvico fabrics.

items.heading: Sculpting shell weight
paragraphs: Sculpting and shaping styles get a heavier 200–220 gsm shell plus a second layer of fabric.

items.heading: Lining weight and coverage
paragraphs: Your lining is a matching nylon-spandex or polyester-spandex of about 110–140 gsm, in the main colour, nude, white or black. Most styles are fully lined. For lighter-weight or lower-price dark styles, you can choose front-only lining.

items.heading: Pool and training performance
paragraphs: For pool and training ranges, we pick chlorine-resistant spandex. You can also add quick-dry performance and four-way stretch to your suits.

items.heading: Beach and surf performance
paragraphs: For beach and surf ranges, we pick UPF 50+ UV-blocking yarns and salt-fade proofing to handle sun exposure and saltwater wear.

blocks.heading: Construction, Bust Support and Trim Details
paragraphs: We match bust support to your cup sizes and neckline. Small-bust fashion styles get shelf linings or light padding, and fuller-bust and cup-sized ranges get underwire or foam cups. Your options include removable cups in sewn-in pockets, fixed padding, power-mesh shelf linings, built-in shelf bras and underwire channels. Underwire styles can also take foam cups or power mesh.

We flatlock the side seams and finish the edges with fold-over elastic or turned, coverstitched picot elastic, depending on your price point. High-cut styles get silicone-backed leg elastic so they don't ride up. Our [swimwear hardware options](/swimwear-hardware/) include zinc-alloy rings and sliders with gold or silver plating.

blocks.heading: Size Range and Grading Specs from XS to 3XL
paragraphs: Send us your target size chart and customer profile before grading, and we'll set the base size and grading steps for your market.
rows: XS to 3XL, with custom grading to your chart. We send the full chart on request.

Frequently Asked Questions

items.question: Can you manufacture one-pieces using fabric we supply, and what stretch and recovery requirements must that fabric meet?
items.answer: Yes. We make one-pieces from your fabric if it has at least 15% spandex, at least 60% four-way stretch in each direction and at least 90% recovery.

items.question: Which one-piece construction choices push the unit price up, such as underwire cups, rings and sliders, cut-outs, double-layer fabric, zips or long sleeves?
items.answer: Each of these adds construction steps, trims or fabric, so each one raises your unit price, and combining them raises it further. Your quote also reflects your fabric and its availability, the printing method, print placement and number of printed panels, custom trims, branding and quantity, with orders starting at 50 pieces per style in each colour. Send complete front-and-back images or a tech pack, and you get detailed costs within 2 to 3 working days.

items.question: How do you make sure a white or pastel one-piece is not see-through when it gets wet?
items.answer: We keep white and pastel one-pieces opaque when wet by adding lining, a double layer or a lined front panel, or by using a heavier fabric.

items.question: How do you size a one-piece offered in cup sizes, and up to which cup size can you go?
items.answer: We make cup-sized one-pieces on request. We grade each band-and-cup combination to your chart and count each combination as one size. Our Plus Size Swimwear programme supports up to G cups, and our standard one-piece range runs from XS to 3XL.

items.question: How do you prevent laser-cut hollow-out edges from curling or tearing during repeated stretching and wear?
items.answer: We only laser-cut fabrics with at least 18% spandex, so the heat seals the edges and they don't fray. Inside each opening we bond 1 cm clear elastic or heat-seal tape to stop the edges curling. To stop tears when the suit stretches, we leave at least 1.5 cm between openings and round every corner to a radius of at least 3 mm.

steps.heading: Confirmation and production

steps.heading: Standards and inspection

blocks.heading: Bikini Sets and Separates in Sizes XS to 5XL
columns: What we make and how you allocate sizes
rows: A matching top and bottom count as one piece with a single size split. You skip separate minimums, so sets cost less when you're starting with a small range.
Each separate needs 50 pieces per style in each colour, split across 3 to 4 sizes. Our standard S:M:L:XL ratio is 1:2:2:1, and your sales data sets your actual split.
Separates let you order different ratios for tops and bottoms, such as more larger-cup tops alongside S and M bottoms. When your customers' top and bottom sizes differ, this cuts your unsold stock.
Our standard grading from XS to 3XL is free, and our plus-size line goes up to 4XL and 5XL. Underwired tops cover bands 30 through 46, including the larger bands in our plus-size line.

Before grading, we check each style against your measurement sheet on a size M fit model, or a 2XL model for plus sizes. Your chart sets the band and cup grading, and every pairing counts as a separate size.
Our [plus-size bikinis](/plus-size-swimwear-manufacturer/) are built with wider straps, secure elastics and supportive construction.

blocks.heading: Custom Bikini Fabrics, Linings and Support

items.heading: Fabric feel
paragraphs: Nylon-spandex feels softer and smoother on wet skin, with a close, sculpting stretch and quick recovery. Polyester-spandex dries faster, stays more stable and is easier to look after.

items.heading: Chlorine and sun
paragraphs: Polyester-spandex holds its shape better through repeated chlorine and sun exposure. For nylon styles, we offer chlorine-resistant LYCRA Xtra Life to extend stretch recovery.

items.heading: Support construction
paragraphs: We match the construction to cup size and use. Foam cups or power mesh give lighter support. Larger cups and active styles need underwire, reinforced elastics and adjustable straps and hardware to keep their shape when wet.

items.heading: Structure trade-offs
paragraphs: Lighter builds stretch out quickly under heavier busts. Underwire and extra hardware add cost and development time, and they make lounging tops less soft and packable.

items.heading: Lining and coverage
paragraphs: You can choose full or front-only swim lining in nude, white, black or a shade matched to the shell, and you can ask for recycled lining. White and pale colours need full lining, double layers, a lined front panel or a heavier shell fabric.

items.heading: Your supplied components
paragraphs: We work with your own fabric, cups and underwires. Send 2 cups and 2 underwires per cup size for sample fit, chlorine and salt-water checks. Then supply the bulk components with 3% extra cups and underwires.

items.heading: Sourcing choices
paragraphs: Through [Swimwear Fabrics & Sourcing](/swimwear-fabrics-sourcing/), we offer 80% nylon 20% spandex, matching linings, and ECONYL, REPREVE and Italian Carvico on request. We also offer textured, ribbed, satin, glitter, metallic, sequin, towel and leather fabrics.

items.heading: Branded hardware
paragraphs: Through [Swimwear Hardware](/swimwear-hardware/), custom moulds cost USD 200 each. Resin O-rings need 100 pieces per colour, logo metal tags 100 pieces. For trims you supply, send 2 test pieces of each, then 3% extra that arrives at least 7 days before cutting.

blocks.heading: Bikini Reinforcement, Edge Finishes and Lacing Details

items.heading: Reinforced stress points
paragraphs: We reinforce the straps, side seams and crotch on every style. Putting a bikini on and wearing it wet puts strain on these points, and once one of them fails, the garment is finished.

items.heading: Stitched elastic edges
paragraphs: We fold rubber or swim-grade elastic into a binding, or turn it and coverstitch it. Stitched elastic gives your ties and leg openings the firmest grip and lasts the longest.

items.heading: Bonded minimal finishes
paragraphs: Bonded and laser-cut edges lie flatter and can't be seen under clothing. They hold less tension, though, so they suit lighter-support tops and cheeky bottoms. We keep the reinforcement flat and narrow so it adds as little bulk as possible.

items.heading: Eyelets and lacing
paragraphs: You can add eyelets and lacing as embellishments or special finishes. We choose each edge finish to match the tension that part of the garment carries.

items.heading: Hand-applied decoration
paragraphs: Our [Embroidery service](/swimwear-embroidery/) adds beads, sequins, stones, rhinestones, beaded chains, appliqués, embroidered patches and crochet trims to your bikinis and cover-ups. We work the crochet by hand and sew on each bead and sequin one at a time. None are glued or heat-pressed.

Frequently Asked Questions

items.question: Does the sample fee cover a full bikini set, or are the top and bottom charged as separate samples?
items.answer: If we develop a matching top and bottom together, they count as one sample at USD 50, plus USD 50 for courier delivery. A top or bottom developed on its own is charged as its own sample. Each physical fit revision costs another USD 50 and adds courier time. We don't refund these fees or credit them against your bulk order. Minor digital adjustments are free. You'll avoid extra rounds if you finalise your size chart, measurement sheet and construction details before sampling starts. Underwire, reversible and laced builds need at least one physical revision for a wear check.

items.question: Which construction and trim choices on a bikini add the most to the price, compared with a basic lined triangle set?
items.answer: Cup construction adds the most: underwire, moulded or removable cups, and power mesh. Next come extra hardware, reversible or double-layer builds, hand-applied embellishment, sublimation printing and the packaging format you choose. Branded or recycled fabrics also raise the price.

items.question: Which of your metallic, glitter, velvet and other fashion-finish bikini fabrics suit repeated pool or sea swimming rather than mainly dry resort wear?
items.answer: Our swim velvet suits regular sea swimming. It's a 240 g/m² blend of 90% polyamide and 10% spandex that resists salt water and gives UV protection. Metallic foil, glitter and other surface coatings are for mainly dry resort wear, because repeated chlorine exposure dulls their sparkle. For styles that will see a lot of pool swimming, we use solid-dyed or printed nylon and polyester, including chlorine-resistant LYCRA Xtra Life.

items.question: How do you construct reversible bikinis so seams, padding and closures work with either side worn outward?
items.answer: We sew layers with matching stretch as two finished outer faces and enclose the seam allowances, so no overlocking shows on either side. The inner cup pocket has a 6 cm opening, so the padding comes out whichever side is facing outward. We use double-sided rings, slides or tie strings in place of one-sided hooks, and we wear-check both sides before bulk production.

items.question: How are the ends of your bikini strings and lacing finished so they don't fray or slip out of the eyelets?
items.answer: We turn in and bar-tack the ends of self-fabric tubes, or heat-seal the cord tips. You can also choose metal or silicone tips, or beads. Lacing ends get knots or stoppers at least 3 mm wider than the eyelet opening. Before packing, we pull-test the strings and eyelets at 70 N.

We have been operating since 2011. Our [factory and in-house team](/about-us/) keep production and export under our direct control. We run around the clock with a capacity of about 100,000 pieces a month, and our 65-person sampling studio completes about 55 custom samples a day.

blocks.heading: From Tech Pack to Delivery: Lead Times and Shipping Terms
paragraphs: For new labels, our [Launch service](/swimwear-launch-services/) starter pack gives you three finished samples, twenty fabric swatches, a stock-style catalogue and a launch guide.

steps.heading: Send your brief
steps.text: To get a [free quote](/request-a-quote/), email or WhatsApp us your design, fabrics, colours, quantity, sizing and packing needs. We check feasibility and send back estimated pricing and timing.

steps.heading: Develop the sample
steps.text: We turn your brief into a sample for you to approve, so the product is settled before you commit to bulk production.

steps.heading: Confirm order details
steps.text: Before the order is placed, we agree quantities, colours, customisation, availability and lead times with you.

steps.heading: Run bulk production
steps.text: Once you approve the sample and we receive your deposit, bulk production takes 35 to 40 days. Your order size and the season set where it falls in that range.

steps.heading: Supply your packaging
steps.text: For [Swimwear Packaging & Custom Brand Labels](/swimwear-packaging-custom-brand-labels/), send your labels, tags and bags, plus 3% extra, at least 7 days before cutting. We report any shortages or defects within 3 business days.

steps.heading: Ship your order
steps.text: Choose FOB, CIF or worldwide DDP. With DDP, you pay one all-in price for delivery to your door, and we handle duties, customs and freight through our forwarding partners.

blocks.heading: OEM Men's Swimwear Patterns, Samples and Fees
rows: We build custom patterns from your sketch, reference garment or tech pack. A sketch or reference garment takes more sample rounds than a complete tech pack.
We lock the pattern before grading or bulk cutting, while fit and construction are still cheaper to correct.
Your standard sample is ready in 10 to 15 days.
Each sample costs USD 50, and the design fee is USD 50 per design, covering its pattern or print and all its colourways. Neither fee is refunded or credited against your bulk order.
Courier delivery costs you USD 50 on top of the sample fee.
Through our [Development service](/development/), we grade each style from S to 3XL free of charge against US, EU or UK charts, or we develop sizing from your measurements and target market.

blocks.heading: Construction Options: Linings, Waistbands and Trims
paragraphs: We match fabrics, linings and trims to the way your garments are worn and washed.

items.heading: Lining and panel options
paragraphs: You can choose Sport Mesh, Powernet or compression liners. Reinforced seams and cut-out panels are also available for your construction.

items.heading: Waistband structures
paragraphs: For trunks, we use either full elastic with an internal drawcord or a flat front with back elastic. Board shorts get a fixed waistband with a lace-up fly.

items.heading: Secure fly closures
paragraphs: Choose marine-grade hook-and-loop backed with soft tape, snaps, or flat woven lace-up cords with sealed tips running through metal-reinforced eyelets. These secure closures keep the fly shut in surf.

items.heading: Pocket layouts
paragraphs: Specify mesh-lined side pockets, key pockets, cargo pockets or back pockets with drainage eyelets. Trapped water makes trunks drag and balloon.

items.heading: Higher-spec fastening
paragraphs: On higher-spec builds, we fit corrosion-resistant pocket zips under storm flaps, so you get secure fastening along with drainage for swimming and surf.

items.heading: Matched hardware
paragraphs: Our [Swimwear Hardware service](/swimwear-hardware/) supplies colour-matched straps, rings, sliders, hooks and buckles in metal, plastic, resin or eco-friendly materials, as well as drawstrings, eyelets and zippers.

blocks.heading: Shell Fabrics, Linings and Supplied Materials for Men's Swimwear
paragraphs: Your fabric choice comes down to your print method, style and target price.

items.heading: Printing compatibility
items.text: Sublimation needs polyester, because the dye bonds with that fibre. If you want a softer nylon shell, we switch it to pigment inks, printed in our own factory.

items.heading: Fabric choices
items.text: We offer solid, printable and sustainable options, including polyester-spandex, nylon-spandex, PBT, jacquard, compression, UV-protective, chlorine-resistant and athleisure fabrics.

items.heading: Your supplied materials
items.text: We sew the shells and linings you supply, or we import from your mill using its supplier name and fabric code.

items.heading: Specialist fabric sourcing
items.text: Through our [fabric sourcing](/swimwear-fabrics-sourcing/), we offer 80% nylon 20% spandex with matching linings. On request, we also source chlorine-resistant LYCRA Xtra Life, ECONYL, REPREVE and Italian Carvico.

items.heading: Boardshort shell options
items.text: The standard shells for our [boardshorts](/boardshorts-manufacturer/) are 100% polyester microfibre in peach twill or 95% polyester / 5% spandex 4-way stretch.

items.heading: Production certifications
items.text: Our [production certifications](/sustainability/) cover OEKO-TEX Standard 100 for tested fabrics/trims, GRS/RCS for recycled fabrics, bluesign for chemistry, ISO 9001 for quality management and WRAP for social compliance.

blocks.heading: Custom Prints and Colour Matching
paragraphs: Before we start bulk printing, you approve a printed strike-off on the production fabric, with placement set across seams and panels. Colours shift between screens, paper and stretch fabric, and seam alignment becomes visible once garments are cut and sewn. We match colours and align patterns so your whole order stays consistent.
Our [Custom Printing service](/custom-swimwear-printing/) works from your AI or PDF artwork to produce high-resolution all-over or placement designs. The prints resist chlorinated and salt water.

Our [Embroidery service](/swimwear-embroidery/) gives you machine or hand decoration in colours from our thread library. Embroidery and screen printing start at 50 pieces per design, and custom woven labels start at 1,000 pieces.

blocks.heading: Quality Checks from Approved Sample to Bulk Order
paragraphs: We check fit, construction and finishing against your approved sample. We test wet opacity, liner seams, drawcord anchoring and ballooning before grading and again during bulk production.

items.heading: Liner seam strength
items.text: We join soft mesh liners with flat-lock seams and add bar-tacks at the crotch and leg stress points so they don't tear.

items.heading: Drawcord anchoring
items.text: We stitch drawcords to the waistband at centre back and finish them with sealed or silicone tips so they cannot pull out.

items.heading: Water drainage
items.text: We add mesh drainage panels or eyelets to liners and pockets so water drains out and the garment doesn't balloon.

items.heading: Light-colour coverage
items.text: For light colours, we use fabric of 190 to 220 GSM or a full lining to keep coverage.

items.heading: Print base colour
items.text: We sublimate onto fabric pre-dyed close to the main print colour, so white doesn't show through when the fabric stretches.

items.heading: Wet fit testing
items.text: Before grading, we fit each style on a base-size model and wear-test it wet for stretch, coverage and opacity.

items.heading: Independent inspection
items.text: We welcome [independent pre-shipment inspections](/faq/) by SGS or BV, so your appointed inspector can check the goods before dispatch.

items.heading: Defect remedies
items.text: Under our [quality terms](/terms-and-conditions/), you report defects with photos/videos within 7 days of receipt. After we assess them, we repair, remake, replace or credit the pieces. Shipping and handling charges are not refunded.

items.question: Are any of your men's jammers or racing suits World Aquatics-approved for competition, or are they supplied only as training and recreational styles?
items.answer: We don't hold World Aquatics approval, so our jammers and racing suits are training and recreational styles and aren't labelled as competition-approved. If you apply for approval for your own design, we supply the samples and fabric data the application needs.

items.question: How do you construct swim-short liners to prevent inner-thigh chafing and liner ride-up during prolonged swimming or walking?
items.answer: We keep flat-lock seams away from the inner thigh and secure the leg openings with soft elastic or a 1 cm silicone gripper. We also tack the liner to the shell's side seams so it can't twist or ride up. For casual shorts we use soft four-way-stretch sport mesh, and for active wear we use brief-style compression liners with a 2 to 3 inch leg.

items.question: Can you build contoured support pouches or separate front-support panels into men's briefs, jammers and swim-short liners?
items.answer: Yes. In briefs and jammers we sew double-lined front pouches shaped with 2 to 3 seams, or we add separate support panels in powernet or compression fabric. Swim-short liners get the same pouch construction, in brief or boxer-brief cuts made to your measurements.

items.heading: Higher-cost features
paragraphs: Branded or recycled fabrics push the unit price up the most. Next come exclusive all-over prints, compression liners, extra zip or cargo pockets, and embroidered or silicone logos.

items.heading: Lowest-cost build
paragraphs: Unit prices stay lowest with standard polyester or polyester-spandex shells, existing prints, unlined or mesh-lined construction, simple drawcord waists, woven labels and larger quantities per style and colour.

paragraphs: Our [design and development team](/development/) handles patterns, grading and fit in-house, so your collection goes through fewer rounds of design back-and-forth.

items.heading: New-label support
paragraphs: Our [Launch service](/swimwear-launch-services/) offers a starter pack with three finished samples, twenty fabric swatches, a stocked-style catalogue and a launch guide. We also offer separate design-to-manufacturing startup packages and consulting.

blocks.heading: Boardshort Shell Fabrics and Liner Options
paragraphs: We pick the shell and liner together, so the fabric's stretch and weight suit how the liner will be used.

items.heading: Standard shell specifications
paragraphs: For your specification sheet, our 100% polyester microfibre peach twill weighs about 120 GSM, and our 95% polyester / 5% spandex 4-way stretch weighs about 150 GSM.

items.heading: Other performance shells
paragraphs: Quick-dry nylon weighs about 110 GSM and is lightweight, durable and water-resistant. You can also choose 4-way stretch polyester, quick-dry and UV-resistant fabrics, with DWR specified to AATCC 22 spray rating 80.

items.heading: Recycled polyester options
paragraphs: If your collection is positioned as eco-friendly, we offer recycled polyester shells for your boardshorts, including recycled microfibre as a performance fabric.

items.heading: UPF test conditions

items.heading: Liner by use

blocks.heading: Preventing Common Boardshort Defects
paragraphs: We build defect prevention into sampling, so you test drawcords, eyelets, seams, print fastness and closures before bulk production starts. Every drawcord is bar-tacked at the centre so it can't pull out. Eyelets are rust-proof stainless steel or plastic, so they don't corrode. Inner seams are triple-stitched and flat-finished to reduce chafing. To stop sublimated colours bleeding or fading, we fix the inks at around 200°C and check every print colour for wash fastness on the sample. Closures are soft, low-profile hook-and-loop, with a fabric-flap option, so they don't snag other fabrics.

blocks.heading: Frequently Asked Questions

items.question: Is your DWR finish fluorine-free (PFC/PFAS-free), so the shorts can be sold in markets that restrict PFAS?
items.answer: Yes. The optional DWR finish we offer for trunk and boardshort shells is PFC-free and PFAS-free. It uses fluorine-free chemistry with no fluorinated repellents, so it works for markets that restrict PFAS. Applied over quick-drying fabric, it makes water bead up and run off rather than soak in. We provide the finish supplier's declaration on request.

items.question: How do you adapt waistband drawcords on boys' boardshorts for the age group and destination market's cord-safety requirements?
items.answer: Our boys' boardshorts follow EN 14682, the European standard for cords on children's clothing. We bar-tack waist drawcords at the centre and leave the ends with no toggles or knots. For under-7s, drawcords don't hang outside the garment. For ages 7 to 14, free ends are 14 cm long at most.

items.question: On stretch boardshorts with all-over sublimation, how do you stop white base fabric showing through at the seams and when the fabric stretches?
items.answer: We extend the artwork at least 1 cm past the seam allowance on every cut panel, so no white shows at the seams after sewing or when they open. For dark or strong backgrounds, we use a base fabric dyed close to the main print colour and stretch-test the printed panels to 20% before sewing, so white doesn't grin through in wear.

items.question: Which shell and lining combinations prevent lightweight or pale-coloured boardshorts from becoming see-through when wet?
items.answer: We specify the shell weight together with a full lining, a double layer or a lined front panel, so lightweight or pale boardshorts stay opaque in and out of the water. We check the finished shorts wet and stretched, not just flat and dry.

paragraphs: We've run our [factory-owned production and export business](/about-us/) since 2011, which keeps quality, cost and delivery in our hands. We check incoming fabric and the cutting and sewing, then carry out random checks and a full final inspection.

items.heading: Design development
paragraphs: Through our [OEM and ODM development](/development/), we take your design, picture or idea and do the patterns, grading and fit in-house, so there's less back-and-forth. You approve the sample before bulk production starts.

items.heading: Enquiry response
paragraphs: Whether you're developing a new range or talking through an order, we reply to every [enquiry](/contact-us/) within one business day.

items.heading: Launch support
paragraphs: Our [Launch service](/swimwear-launch-services/) includes a starter pack with three finished samples, twenty fabric swatches, a stock catalogue and a launch guide. We also offer separate design, development and manufacturing packages, plus consulting.

items.heading: Reporting order issues
paragraphs: Under our [terms and conditions](/terms-and-conditions/), you need to report any shortages, defects, late-delivery damages or returns to us in writing within 7 days of receiving your goods.

items.heading: Retail-ready packing
paragraphs: With our [Swimwear Packaging & Custom Brand Labels service](/swimwear-packaging-custom-brand-labels/), your goods arrive retail-ready in 5-ply export cartons. Each carton carries shipping marks and a breakdown by style, colour and size for your warehouse, 3PL or FBA warehouse.

blocks.heading: OEM Swim Trunks Orders: Quotes, Samples, MOQ, Payment and Shipping

items.heading: Minimum and trial orders
items.text: Orders start at 50 pieces per style per colour. For a first trial, we agree the quantity with you case by case, within our production limits.

items.heading: Sample timing and cost
items.text: Once you agree the quoted price, we make a standard sample in 10 to 15 days. Each sample costs USD 50.

items.heading: Design fees
items.text: The pattern or print for each design costs USD 50, and that covers all its colourways. Design and sample fees aren't refunded or credited against bulk orders.

items.heading: Sample courier charge
items.text: Under our [sample delivery terms](/faq/), courier delivery costs USD 50. You pay this separately from the sample fee.

items.heading: Bulk production timing
items.text: Bulk production takes 35 to 40 days from sample approval and receipt of your deposit. The exact timing depends on your order size and the season.

items.heading: Payment split
items.text: You pay a 50% deposit when you confirm the order and the remaining 50% before we ship your goods.

items.heading: Shipping terms
items.text: We ship FOB, CIF or DDP. With worldwide DDP, our forwarding partners handle freight, customs, duties and delivery to your door for one all-in price.

items.heading: Free quotation
items.text: To get a [free quotation](/request-a-quote/), email or WhatsApp us your design or marked-up drawings, along with your fabrics, prints, colours, quantities, sizing and packing requirements. We check that it can be made and send you back pricing and timing.

blocks.heading: Quick-Dry Shell Fabrics and Liner Options

items.heading: Fast-drying polyester
paragraphs: If fast drying matters most, go for our 85/15 polyester spandex. It has around 0.4% moisture regain, dries in about 20–30 minutes in the sun and clings less when wet.

items.heading: Softer recycled nylon
paragraphs: Our recycled nylon absorbs around 4%, dries about 10 minutes slower and sits closer to the body when wet. You give up some drying speed and get a softer feel and stronger stretch recovery in return. Its partner mill uses water-saving dyes.

items.heading: Print compatibility
paragraphs: Nylon doesn't take sublimation printing, so for busy all-over sublimation prints we use polyester, not recycled nylon.

items.heading: Movement and shape
paragraphs: For longer, boardshort-style cuts, tightly woven non-stretch quick-dry polyester holds a crisp shape. For paddling and hard swimming, 4-way stretch with spandex moves with you. Short-inseam trunks use a lighter quick-dry fabric with a built-in liner.

items.heading: Liner choices
paragraphs: Our standard lining is a soft polyester mesh. To suit your market, you can switch to a soft knit brief-style lining or a compression liner, or have the trunks made unlined.

items.heading: Specialist fabric sourcing
paragraphs: Our [fabric sourcing](/swimwear-fabrics-sourcing/) covers nylon and polyester blended with spandex, including 80% nylon 20% spandex with matching linings. On request, we also source chlorine-resistant LYCRA Xtra Life, ECONYL recycled nylon, REPREVE recycled polyester and Italian Carvico.

items.heading: Production credentials
paragraphs: Our [sustainability provisions](/sustainability/) cover regenerated waste fibres, OEKO-TEX Standard 100 for fabrics and trims, GRS and RCS for recycled fabrics, bluesign for chemistry, ISO 9001 for quality management and WRAP for social compliance.

items.heading: Water-repellent finish
paragraphs: With our [trunk and boardshort DWR finish](/boardshorts-manufacturer/), water beads up and runs off. The chemistry is fluorine-free, PFC-free and PFAS-free, so the finish works for PFAS-restricted markets, and we can send you a declaration from the finish supplier on request.

blocks.heading: Waistband, Seam and Pocket Construction

items.heading: Waistband components
items.text: We enclose 35–40 mm elastic in the waistband and fit adjustable nylon drawcords with metal or moulded tips. Metal eyelets always sit on reinforced backing and never on raw fabric.

items.heading: Lining attachment
items.text: We anchor the mesh at the waistband and tack it at the side seams. Between those points it hangs free, so it drains, dries on its own and doesn't twist.

items.heading: Seams and hems
items.text: We flatlock the inner seams to stop thigh chafing and finish the leg hems with soft elastic or a 1 cm silicone gripper.

items.heading: Sewing cost trade-off
items.text: Tacked linings and flatlock seams take more sewing time than overlocked, fully bagged linings, and that raises your unit cost.

items.heading: Pocket closure choices
items.text: For your trunk design, you can specify corrosion-resistant zips, marine-grade hook-and-loop or mesh-lined zip pockets.

items.heading: Fixed-waist fly options
items.text: You can choose a lace-up fly with hook-and-loop or a waistband snap, a corrosion-resistant zip with a metal snap or moulded button, or a stitched-down faux fly.

items.heading: Hybrid fly details
items.text: Hybrid trunks take a topstitched faux fly or a working zip, snap or hook-and-loop fly. We offer five 1.2 cm belt loops around the waist.

items.heading: Walk-short construction
items.text: For trunks that go from the water to the street, we build a 4 cm flat-front waistband with a button or snap closure, elastic at the back and quick-dry stretch fabric.

blocks.heading: Private Label Swim Trunks: Prints and Branding

items.heading: Private-label branding
paragraphs: On volume orders, we offer silicone patches at the hem or waistband, heat-transfer logos, embroidered marks, centre-back woven labels, logo drawcord tips and branded eyelet hardware.

items.heading: Pocket pattern matching
paragraphs: Before cutting, we map your print across the patch pockets and the panels underneath. Then we check on a pre-production sample that it lines up to within 3–5 mm. Curves and stretch zones shift motifs, so we keep your key artwork clear of them.

items.heading: Branding cost trade-offs
paragraphs: Pattern-matched pockets create more cutting waste, and every extra branding point raises the unit price. On a simple style, a single woven label or patch keeps your branding costs lower.

items.heading: Style-specific pricing
paragraphs: Liners, zip pockets, colour-block panels and branded hardware all raise unit prices. We quote from your specification, fabric, trims, logos and quantity, and we confirm bulk pricing after review. Taking details out or swapping them for others brings the cost down.

items.heading: Logo finish durability
paragraphs: Our [Custom Printing service](/custom-swimwear-printing/) offers three logo finishes. Thin, flexible transfers suit low-wear areas. Raised silicone holds its shape. Embroidery is durable but stretches the least, so we give it a soft backing and use it on low-stretch areas.

items.heading: Embroidery and label minimums
paragraphs: Our [Embroidery service](/swimwear-embroidery/) offers machine or hand work in standard, 3D, reflective or stone finishes, with thread colours from our available library. Embroidery and screen printing need 50 pieces per design. Custom woven labels need 1,000 pieces.

blocks.heading: Related products and services
Frequently Asked Questions

items.question: Can you manufacture trunks using shell and lining fabric that we supply, and what material limitations would prevent you from accepting them?
items.answer: Yes. We cut and sew shell and lining fabrics you supply, or we import them from your mill using its supplier name and fabric code. Sublimation printing needs polyester, so on nylon we use digital pigment printing instead.

items.question: If I order light or white colours, how do you stop the trunks from going see-through when wet?
items.answer: We use a dense 190–220 GSM warp-knit tricot for the shell and add a lining, a double layer of self fabric or a lined front panel. When there's a separate lining, we make it from 140 GSM stretch tricot.

items.question: Is the drawcord secured inside the waistband, or can it slip out through the eyelets in use or in the wash?
items.answer: We secure it with a 1 cm bar-tack at centre back inside the waistband, so it can't pull through when the trunks are worn or washed. The metal or moulded tips are bigger than the eyelet opening, which gives you a second stop.

items.question: What minimum order do you need before you can put my logo on the drawcord tips and make branded eyelets?
items.answer: Logo hardware starts at 1,000 pieces per item. Before we add a logo to the tips, we review your artwork and the tip material. Branded eyelets need their own tooling, so we quote once we've confirmed the tooling, finish, size and quantity.

items.question: Can you add vents or other drainage features to release trapped air and water from loose-fitting trunks?
items.answer: Yes. We build drainage into loose-fitting trunks so trapped air and water can get out, which stops ballooning and drag. You can choose two reinforced 6 mm metal grommets at the rear rise, mesh panels up to 8 cm high in each side seam, or mesh-lined pockets, on their own or together. Open-mesh side and back pocket bags have eyelets at the base, so they drain even when the zip or hook-and-loop is closed. We mark the vent positions on your sample for you to approve before bulk production starts. Visible vents and mesh change the look and let light through, so they suit light-coloured or close-fitting styles less well.

blocks.heading: UPF 50+ Swim Fabrics and Chlorine Resistance

items.heading: Fabric choices
paragraphs: We offer quick-dry polyester/spandex, nylon/spandex, soft stretch knits and recycled-fibre fabrics. They hold their colour through frequent washing, and we supply chlorine- and salt-water-resistant options on request.

items.heading: Fabric by use
paragraphs: For pool and swim-school ranges, we use chlorine-resistant PBT or elastane blends. For holiday and beach styles, we use softer standard stretch knits.

items.heading: Pool durability trade-off
paragraphs: PBT polyester and chlorine-resistant elastane such as LYCRA Xtra Life hold their shape longer than standard spandex, but they give up some softness and stretch. PBT is firmer and resists chlorine better. Elastane stays softer and stretchier, and it keeps a close fit through weekly lessons.

items.heading: Skin and sun coverage
paragraphs: We choose skin-friendly fabrics, including UPF 50+ materials that block UV rays. Long sleeves give more coverage, and that includes our made-to-order girls' one-pieces.

items.heading: Standard UPF testing
paragraphs: Our UPF 50+ fabrics are lab-tested to AS/NZS 4399, and we supply the documentation. The rating applies to the fabric dry and relaxed, as it was tested.

items.heading: Additional performance tests
paragraphs: If you want to make claims about performance after washing, we arrange accredited-lab testing after 20 or 40 wash cycles, plus wet and stretched testing. You pay the lab fees at cost.

items.heading: Sourcing and toddler certification
paragraphs: Through [Swimwear Fabrics & Sourcing](/swimwear-fabrics-sourcing/), we offer 80% nylon 20% spandex with matching linings. For toddler styles, the fabric, lining and trims are certified to OEKO-TEX Standard 100 Product Class I for harmful substances; CPSIA and REACH need lab tests.

items.heading: Certified sustainable options
paragraphs: Our [sustainability work](/sustainability/) includes certified recycled sourcing and production certifications: OEKO-TEX Standard 100, GRS, RCS, bluesign, ISO 9001 and WRAP. Together they cover tested materials, recycled content, chemistry, quality management and social compliance.

blocks.heading: Soft Linings, Seams and Secure Trims for Comfort

items.heading: Comfort against skin
paragraphs: We use smooth linings, secure elastic and waistbands, and soft seams that won't chafe children's skin.

items.heading: Soft boxer-brief liners
paragraphs: For younger children and long pool sessions, our stretch nylon-spandex boxer-brief liner has flatlock seams and covered leg elastic, so it lies flat and doesn't rub.

items.heading: Mesh or unlined shorts
paragraphs: Mesh briefs suit older boys and fast-drying beachwear. Unlined shorts fit over a swim nappy or separate undershorts.

items.heading: Secure attached components
paragraphs: We sew or rivet on every snap, ring, slider, buckle, bead and trim, and each one has to pass a 90 N pull test.

items.heading: Decoration restrictions
paragraphs: Under-3 sizes have no removable decorations. None of our children's designs use hanging charms, glued or heat-fixed stones, or beads small enough to swallow.

items.heading: Patches and appliqués
paragraphs: We stitch rubber patches and appliqués all the way around the edge instead of relying on glue, so they don't lift with repeated chlorine exposure and washing.

items.heading: Metal hardware testing
paragraphs: Metal hardware is lab-tested to EN 1811 for nickel release and kept within CPSIA lead limits of 100 ppm in base metal and 90 ppm in coatings. For US orders, a CPSC-accepted third-party lab tests your styles at cost.

items.heading: Hardware sourcing service

blocks.heading: Related products and services
Frequently Asked Questions

items.question: Do the drawstrings on your kids' swim trunks meet children's cord and drawstring safety rules for the EU and US, and can you make the waist without a free cord?
items.answer: Yes. Our trunks and beach sets follow EN 14682, and we offer a covered flat elastic waistband, 2 to 3 cm wide, with no drawcord. Our tops follow ASTM F1816, so there are no drawstrings at the hood or neck. Waist drawcords are bar-tacked at the centre, with no toggles or knots. On under-7 sizes the drawcord stays inside the garment, and for ages 7 to 14 the free ends are 14 cm long at most.

items.question: How do you make sure white and pastel kids' swimsuits are not see-through when wet?
items.answer: To keep white and pastel suits opaque when wet, we use heavier fabric, a lining, a double layer or a lined front panel. During sampling, we check the suit wet and stretched, and that tells us which construction to use.

items.question: Can you print licensed cartoon or character artwork on kids' swimwear, and what licence authorisation do I need to provide?
items.answer: We print licensed characters, logos and trademarks only when you give us a written licence from the rights holder that covers the product type and sales territory. Send it to us before sampling. Without it, we can't sample or produce the artwork.

items.question: On front-zip kids' swimsuits, how do you stop the zip from pinching or rubbing the child's chin and skin?
items.answer: On children's one-pieces and rash guards, a fabric zip garage covers the puller under the chin, and a soft, full-length inner placket sits behind the zip. For toddlers, you can choose a 3-snap crotch or a front or back entry zip. Snaps have soft backing behind them, zips are guarded, and snap and puller attachments are tested to 90 N. For infants, the options are crotch or shoulder snaps and full-length front or back zips. Every zip has a soft guard running the full length of the track, so the teeth and metal stay off the skin.

items.question: Can you make separate fits for toddlers in swim nappies and for toilet-trained toddlers?
items.answer: Yes, we cut separate patterns. The swim-nappy fit adds 2 to 3 cm to the standard seat and rise and widens the leg openings, while the toilet-trained fit keeps the standard seat, rise and leg openings. We sample both for your approval before bulk, because a nappy layer added to a standard pattern changes the fit and the suit leaks or pulls.

items.question: Can you make tween and teen bikinis and tankinis with more coverage?
items.answer: Yes. We make tankinis with more coverage, including cross-strap tops with swim shorts, as well as age-appropriate bikinis. Tops come high-neck or as sporty crops, and bottoms come full-coverage or mid-rise, or as swim shorts or skirted bottoms.
