blocks.heading: Metals, Plating and Surface Finishes

items.heading: Default metal
paragraphs: Our rings, sliders, hooks, buckles, clasps, stoppers and tags are made from high-grade zinc alloy. Our hardware suppliers electroplate them in nickel-free gold or silver, with no chrome or lead.

items.heading: Forming and preparation
paragraphs: Our hardware suppliers die-cast zinc alloy rings, sliders and clasps in steel moulds and stamp flat tags from sheet. They deburr, tumble and polish the parts before plating and anti-rust coating.

items.heading: Water protection
paragraphs: Our anti-rust topcoat stops seawater and pool chlorine from causing corrosion, rust, tarnishing, pitting or fabric stains. Our suppliers test it for long-term wear.

items.heading: Stainless steel grades
paragraphs: If you want stainless steel instead, you can specify grade 304 for general use or marine-grade 316L for long exposure to seawater and chlorinated pools.

items.heading: Brass alternatives
paragraphs: For brass, we offer lead-free H62 brass with 62% copper and 38% zinc, or H65 with 65% copper and 35% zinc.

items.heading: Skin-contact testing
paragraphs: An accredited partner lab tests every metal grade to EN 1811 for nickel release. If you need hypoallergenic trims, we specify nickel-free plating lab-tested to EN 1811.

items.heading: Colours and surfaces
paragraphs: Rings, sliders, hooks and stoppers come in gold, silver, rose gold or gunmetal, each in gloss or matte, with a polished, brushed or powder-coated surface.

items.heading: Production credentials
paragraphs: Our [sustainability credentials](/sustainability/) include OEKO-TEX Standard 100 for tested fabrics and trims, GRS and RCS for recycled fabrics, bluesign for chemistry, ISO 9001 for quality management and WRAP for social compliance.

blocks.heading: Custom Colours and Logo Branding on Metal Parts

items.heading: Colour selection
paragraphs: We give you Pantone references for most hardware items, and larger orders qualify for custom colour matching to your palette.

items.heading: Logo application
paragraphs: Our suppliers engrave or emboss your logo on metal buckles, sliders and charms. We check your artwork against each part before we develop the mould.

items.heading: Small-part artwork
paragraphs: On stoppers and sliders, your logo needs to be at least 3 mm high, with lines at least 0.3 mm wide. Below that size, we use initials or a monogram instead of detailed artwork so the mark stays sharp after plating.

items.heading: Physical approval samples
paragraphs: Logo or custom-colour hardware samples take about 2 to 3 weeks after you approve the artwork. Standard parts colour-matched to your fabric take 7 to 10 days.

items.heading: Bulk release
paragraphs: We start bulk hardware only after you sign off the sample. If you ask, we fit the approved parts onto your garment sample.

items.heading: Garment branding service
paragraphs: Our [Swimwear Packaging & Custom Brand Labels service](/swimwear-packaging-custom-brand-labels/) supplies standard heat-transfer labels with your logo, care and size information, along with hygiene liners and hang tags. You can also add woven labels, silicone logos, fabric tags, logo cards and branded packaging.

blocks.heading: Pull Strength, Cycle and Temperature Ratings
paragraphs: Our force and cycle ratings apply to the part on its own. Once the closure is sewn into your garment sample, we check again that it holds.
rows: Hold 3–5 kg of pull force; metal rings and front clasps hold 8–10 kg.
Rated for more than 1,000 open-and-close cycles.

Our [children's swimwear requirements](/children-s-swimwear-manufacturer/) cover sewn or riveted trims that pass 90 N, no removable decorations for under-3s, and no hanging charms, glued or heat-fixed stones or swallowable beads. Patches and appliqués are fully edge-stitched, nickel is lab-tested to EN 1811, and lead stays within CPSIA limits of 100 ppm in base metal and 90 ppm in coatings. For US children's orders, a CPSC-accepted lab tests your styles at cost.

blocks.heading: Choosing and Fitting Hardware to Your Design

steps.heading: Mark your design
steps.text: Send us a sketch, photo or tech pack showing where each piece of hardware goes, the finished strap width, and whether the part carries load or is decorative.

steps.heading: Select the hardware
steps.text: We recommend the type, size and placement for your style, balancing function, appearance and budget.

steps.heading: Secure strap fittings
steps.text: During production, we loop rings and sliders onto the strap ends, then fold the fabric back, stitch it and bar-tack it.

steps.heading: Reinforce closure positions
steps.text: We sew hooks and clasps into reinforced fabric channels, and we press or rivet snaps through reinforced layers.

steps.heading: Prepare grommet supports
steps.text: We back each hole with fused interfacing or double fabric that extends 10 mm around it. We place grommets at least 15 mm from seams and edges and press them in with matching washers.

steps.heading: Test before bulk
steps.text: Before bulk production begins, we pull-test the fitted grommets on your garment sample at 70 N.

blocks.heading: Costing, Sampling and Checks on Supplied Hardware

items.heading: Supplied-part checks
items.text: Send us 2 pieces of each item. Before we accept your bulk hardware, we check fit, chlorine resistance and salt-water resistance on your actual sample fabric.

items.heading: Bulk trim arrival
items.text: Ship your hardware with 3% extra so it reaches our factory at least 7 days before scheduled cutting. We plan cutting around when it arrives.

items.heading: Our hardware supply
items.text: We supply our own hardware as part of garment production, or separately at the applicable hardware minimums.

items.heading: Standard sample timing
items.text: Once we agree on price, we prepare a standard sample in 10 to 15 days.

items.heading: Sample and design fees
items.text: Each sample costs USD 50. Design costs USD 50 per design, which covers its pattern or print and all its colourways. Neither fee is refunded or credited.

items.heading: Delivery and inspection
items.text: Under our [sample delivery and inspection terms](/faq/), you pay USD 50 for sample courier delivery on top of sampling fees. Independent pre-shipment inspectors, including SGS or BV, are welcome.

items.heading: Costing before sampling
items.text: Through our [quotation process](/request-a-quote/), choosing components takes about a week, or longer when it depends on suppliers. We then calculate your garment and bulk requirements and costs, and sampling starts once we agree on price.

blocks.heading: Minimum Orders, Lead Times, Payment and Shipping

items.heading: Garment order minimum
items.text: Your garment order starts at 50 pieces per style in each colour, which suits small and growing labels.

items.heading: First trial run
items.text: We agree your first-trial quantity case by case. How flexible we can be depends on production requirements.

items.heading: Bulk production timing
items.text: Once you approve the sample and we receive your deposit, bulk production takes 35 to 40 days. Order size and season decide where in that range your order falls.

items.heading: Payment stages
items.text: You pay a 50% deposit when you confirm the order and the remaining 50% before we ship.

items.heading: Shipping terms
items.text: We ship on FOB, CIF or worldwide DDP terms. With DDP, one all-in price covers door delivery, duties, customs and freight, handled through our forwarding partners.

items.heading: Enquiry response
items.text: We reply to every [enquiry](/contact-us/) within one business day, so you know when our answer will arrive.

blocks.heading: Trims, Hardware Minimums and Logo Mould Fees

items.heading: Starting with stock
paragraphs: As a new brand, you keep your starting order simpler with stock hardware. If you add logos to one or two signature parts, the custom minimums and mould fees below apply.

items.heading: Supporting swimwear trims
paragraphs: We also supply power mesh, adjustable bra straps, decorative braided cords and chlorine-resistant elastic. Our nylon/spandex or polyester straps and elastics range from 3 mm to 25 mm. They recover at least 95% after 100 cycles and withstand more than 200 hours of chlorine exposure.

items.heading: Standard hardware minimums
paragraphs: Standard hardware starts at 100 to 500 pieces per colour or size, depending on the item. Resin O-rings start at 100 pieces per colour.

items.heading: Custom hardware minimums
paragraphs: Logo or embossed stoppers, clasps, hooks, sliders and rings, along with special finishes, start at 1,000 pieces per item. Logo or embossed metal tags start at 100 pieces.

items.heading: Mould development charges
paragraphs: Each custom logo ring, slider, hook, clasp or stopper carries a USD 200 mould development fee. Its design sets the unit price.

items.heading: Exclusive mould use
paragraphs: Once you've paid, your logo mould is reserved for your brand only. We keep it for 2 years after your last order and reuse it on reorders with no new mould fee.

items.heading: Stock and samples
paragraphs: Stock hardware is ready in 3 to 7 days. Sample sets cover most items, and you can get physical samples once you've browsed our catalogue.

items.heading: Hardware shipment checks
paragraphs: Our metal hardware is lab-tested to EN 1811 for nickel release, and we quality-check every item before it ships.

blocks.heading: Quality Control and Hardware Testing

items.heading: Mechanical durability
items.text: We test clasps, rings and other hardware for stretch and durability before they go into your production.

items.heading: Exposure resistance
items.text: Our corrosion testing for swimwear hardware covers chlorine resistance, salt spray and UV exposure.

items.heading: Relevant test reports
items.text: We send reports on request. Your report needs to cover the exact material and finish you ordered, not just the product line.

Frequently Asked Questions

items.question: Which hardware choices raise or lower the cost per piece of my swimsuit?
items.answer: Plastic and resin, standard sizes and stock gloss gold or silver finishes keep your costs lowest. Your unit cost goes up with stainless steel or brass instead of zinc alloy, larger sizes, rose gold, gunmetal, matte plating, custom Pantone matching and logo engraving or embossing. Each custom logo hardware item also carries a one-off USD 200 mould fee.

items.question: What load capacities are available for rings, sliders, front clasps and buckles used in supportive swimwear?
items.answer: Our metal rings and front clasps hold 8 to 10 kg, sliders hold 5 to 8 kg before the strap slips, and plastic buckles hold 4 to 6 kg. For supportive and larger-cup swimwear, we specify 25 mm or 32 mm metal parts. These ratings cover the part on its own, so we confirm the closure holds in your sewn garment sample.

items.question: How many hours of salt-spray, chlorine and UV exposure does the hardware withstand without corroding or fading?
items.answer: In lab tests, our metal hardware passes 48 hours of neutral salt spray to ISO 9227, 72 hours soaking in chlorinated pool water and 100 hours of UV exposure. To pass, it has to show no corrosion, rust or colour change at the end.

items.question: Can you cover rings and sliders in the same fabric as my swimsuit?
items.answer: Yes. We wrap rings, sliders and buckles from 15 mm to 50 mm in your swimsuit fabric, over plastic or metal cores. During production, we use fabric from your bulk run so each colourway matches.

items.question: What is the minimum quantity and the development time for custom-moulded, colour-matched beads or a custom rhinestone motif?
items.answer: Custom-moulded, colour-matched beads start at 1,000 pieces per design and colour. Development takes about 2 to 3 weeks, including a colour-matched approval sample. Custom rhinestone motifs start at 300 motifs per design, and a sample takes about 7 to 10 days.

items.question: Are your metal rings cast closed, welded or split, and which constructions are available for load-bearing straps?
items.answer: Our metal rings are die-cast as one solid closed piece, with no weld seams or splits. For load-bearing halter, neck and back straps, we use only closed cast metal rings of 15 mm and above, not split rings or light plastic parts. Split rings are for hanging charms and tags only.

hero.heading: Swimwear Fabric and Sourcing from Our Guangzhou Factory

blocks.heading: Swim Fabrics Imported Direct from Italian Mills
paragraphs: Most of the swimwear we make uses 80% nylon 20% spandex at 180–200 GSM, and on request we import Italian fabrics such as Carvico directly from the knitting mills. If you want a fabric we don't stock, send us its name, or the supplier name and fabric code. We can also import from the mill you already use. Just give us the supplier name and code.

blocks.heading: Fabric Blends, Branded Fabrics and Mill Minimums

items.heading: Swimwear hardware
paragraphs: Our [Swimwear Hardware](/swimwear-hardware/) range includes power mesh, adjustable bra straps, braided cords and chlorine-resistant elastics. Our nylon/spandex or polyester straps and elastics come in widths from 3 to 25 mm. They recover at least 95% of their stretch after 100 cycles and hold up to more than 200 hours of chlorine exposure.

items.heading: Blends and specialist fabrics
paragraphs: We make nylon-spandex and polyester-spandex swimwear with matching linings. On request, we source chlorine-resistant elastane, recycled nylon, recycled polyester and Italian fabrics.

paragraphs: If you use your own supplier or a mill other than Carvico, the minimum is 50 to 100 m per fabric and colour, set by each mill. We check it before costing, and we store any leftover metres free of charge for your later runs.

items.heading: Component selection and costing
paragraphs: Our [quotation process](/request-a-quote/) starts with choosing your fabric, ribbon, hardware and tags. This takes about a week, or longer depending on the suppliers. We then use the component quantities per piece and your bulk order size to set your estimated production cost and total product cost.

items.text: Orders start at 50 pieces per style in each colour, which gives small and growing labels a way in.

blocks.heading: Our Own Guangzhou Factory for Fabric Sourcing
paragraphs: We make your swimwear in our own factory. There is just one, and it is in Guangzhou, Guangdong, China. As a [factory-owning company](/about-us/), we handle both production and export ourselves, so quality, cost and delivery stay under our direct control. To [contact our team](/contact-us/), use email, WhatsApp or the contact form on our website.

blocks.heading: 80/20 Nylon-Spandex and Our Stock Fabric Options

items.heading: Our main blend
paragraphs: Most of the swimwear we make uses 80% nylon and 20% spandex, in weights of 180–200 GSM.

items.heading: Collection fabric choices
paragraphs: For print-led collections, we use polyester-spandex. We also offer nylon-spandex and recycled options. We choose between nylon, polyester, spandex and Lycra for stretch, UV resistance, performance and long wear.

items.heading: Stock and imported colours
paragraphs: Use stock colours for your core shades and save imports for the colours that define your collection. Imported Carvico minimums are 70 m for Vita and Sumatra and 50 m for Pantelleria.

blocks.heading: Nylon-Spandex Swim Fabrics: Weight, Stretch and Best Use
columns: What it means for your styles
rows: This fabric is 78% recycled nylon and 22% spandex at 190 gsm. It stretches in four directions, gives UPF 50+ protection and resists chlorine and salt water. It performs on a par with premium Italian swim fabrics.
Usable width is 145 to 150 cm. Four-way stretch is about 180% lengthwise and 200% widthwise, with recovery of 90% or more. Each fabric's spec sheet comes with your quotation.
In mid and dark colours, our 190 to 230 g/m² recycled performance, soft-touch and micro-terry fabrics work as a single layer.
With 175 to 180 g/m² fabrics, we add a lining, a double layer or a lined front panel.
The lighter 180 to 190 g/m² fabrics suit triangle bikinis, string styles and fashion pieces. Linings or pads add extra shaping.
Our 230 g/m² soft-touch knit holds more firmly and lies smoother over the torso, so it works for one-pieces, larger cups, high-waist bottoms and shaping styles.
You get a smoother, denser hand, a cleaner face, a broader seasonal colour card and tight shade matching between dye lots, so your repeat orders stay consistent.
Core shades cost less in fabric and have no mill minimum, so they suit first runs and smaller collections.

blocks.heading: Which Fabrics Take Digital Prints
paragraphs: If your collection is printed, our nylon-based recycled micro-terry, recycled crinkle, recycled metallic and post-consumer recycled nylon all take [digital printing](/custom-swimwear-printing/). Recycled polyester corduroy rib takes sublimation, which gives sharp, clean detail. Post-consumer recycled nylon also works for your plain-colour styles.

blocks.heading: Chlorine, Salt Water and UPF Performance

items.heading: Additional claim testing
paragraphs: If you want to claim more than the dry, relaxed rating, you need extra testing. We can arrange wet, stretched, selected-colourway, EU EN 13758-1 or US AATCC 183 tests through an accredited lab, and you pay the fees at cost.

items.heading: Pool and training
paragraphs: If your styles are for regular use in chlorinated pools and for training, we choose recycled performance fabric or a fabric built on chlorine-resistant elastane such as LYCRA Xtra Life.

items.heading: Beach and fashion
paragraphs: Metallic knits, high-shine charmeuse, micro-terry, crinkle and soft-touch fabrics are for beachwear and fashion styles, not for regular pool training.

items.heading: Standard UPF testing
paragraphs: Our UPF 50+ fabrics are lab-tested to AS/NZS 4399, the Australia and New Zealand standard, and we give you the documentation. The rating applies to the fabric when it's dry and relaxed.

blocks.heading: Recycled Content and Fabric Certifications
paragraphs: Our recycled materials are GRS certified. All of the recycled content comes from fishing nets, plastic bottles and post-consumer waste, and we give you the GRS documentation to back up your claims. Our [production certifications](/sustainability/) are OEKO-TEX Standard 100 for tested fabrics and trims, GRS and RCS for recycled fabrics, bluesign for chemistry, ISO 9001 for quality management and WRAP for social compliance.

blocks.heading: Swim Fabric Swatch Kits and Samples
paragraphs: Order our real-fabric swatch kit before sampling so you can compare hand, sheen, stretch and print quality side by side. The kit has five Italian nylon swatches, two recycled lustre swatches, three high-shine charmeuse swatches, one recycled micro-terry swatch, four recycled nylon digital prints and three recycled polyester sublimation prints. It also includes samples of recycled performance, recycled metallic, recycled sparkle and mesh fabric.

Each garment sample costs USD 50. The design fee is USD 50 per design, which covers its pattern or print in every colourway. We don't refund either fee, and neither one is credited against bulk orders.

blocks.heading: Pantone Colour Matching and Custom Dyeing

items.heading: Included colour matching
paragraphs: Pantone matching is included for fabric, screen printing and sublimation. Send us a Pantone reference or a physical swatch, and that includes team or club colours.

items.heading: Approval before bulk
paragraphs: During sampling we confirm whether your colour can be achieved. We then make one round of lab dips on the actual production fabric for you to approve.

items.heading: Custom dyeing requirements
paragraphs: Custom-dyed fabric takes about 4 weeks from your deposit. It has a 100-metre minimum and a USD 110 surcharge. For small runs, use our in-stock colour cards instead.

items.heading: Colour and accessory timing
paragraphs: Send us your requirements for custom colours and branded accessories, and we'll confirm the timing for those parts of your order.

blocks.heading: Wet Opacity, Linings and Fabric Care
paragraphs: White and pale swimwear risks turning see-through when it's wet. For light colours, we build your styles with 190 to 220 g/m² shell fabric plus a lining, a double layer or a lined front panel, and we use a matching 140 g/m² lining. We confirm opacity on a wet sample. Then we check the finished garment wet and stretched before you approve bulk production.

visuals.caption: Fabric weights for light colours

blocks.heading: Chlorine Resistance and Fabric Testing
paragraphs: Before we cut your bulk fabric, our partner lab tests chlorine resistance and colour fastness after repeated chlorine exposure. We also test stretch and recovery to check that the fabric returns to shape after wear and time in the water. Strength, softness and durability get tested too. The tests you request depend on how your product will be used.

blocks.heading: What Drives Your Fabric Cost
paragraphs: Standard nylon- or polyester-spandex blends cost less, so they suit your basics. Branded or recycled LYCRA Xtra Life, Carvico, ECONYL and REPREVE fabrics cost more and suit your hero styles. Your quotation shows the fabric difference separately so you can compare. Italian fabric adds the most when your order can't use up a full mill minimum. Metallic yarns, textured surfaces and custom dyeing also cost more than stock colours.

Frequently Asked Questions

items.question: Can I buy sourced swimwear fabric without a garment order?
items.answer: No. We only source fabric for garments we make for you. We import or source the cloth you choose, then cut and sew it into your styles.

items.question: Can several styles jointly meet a mill minimum?
items.answer: Yes. When styles share the same fabric and colour, we combine them into one fabric order: 70 m for Carvico Vita and Sumatra, or 50 m for Pantelleria. Each style still needs 50 pieces per colour. If you confirm shared fabrics and colours early, we start imports before sampling and production.

items.question: How much time does importing fabric add?
items.answer: Importing from Italy or from your own mill adds about 7 to 10 days before sampling, because the sample yardage is couriered. It adds about 3 to 5 weeks before bulk for knitting or dyeing and shipping. Our 10 to 15 days for sampling and 35 to 40 days for bulk start once the fabric arrives. Bulk also needs your sample approval and your deposit.

items.question: Can you reserve fabric for repeat orders?
items.answer: Yes. Once you confirm a repeat collection, we book fabric and colour against your forecast up to 6 months ahead and keep your leftover metres for your next run. If the mill discontinues the fabric, we tell you at least 8 weeks ahead and send two or three matched alternatives for you to approve before bulk.

items.question: Which linings are available, and when do you match the shell or use nude?
items.answer: We offer nylon-spandex or recycled-nylon-spandex linings at about 110 to 140 g/m² in white, black, nude or colours matched to your shell. Your recycled-fabric styles get recycled lining. We match the shell for dark, bright, reversible and visible-edge styles. Nude goes under white, pale colours and light prints so the lining doesn't show through.

items.heading: Sample approval
items.text: You judge the quality on samples first. Your bulk order goes ahead once you've approved them.

items.heading: Production certifications
items.text: Our [certifications](/sustainability/) are OEKO-TEX Standard 100 for fabrics and trims, GRS/RCS for recycled fabrics, bluesign for chemistry, ISO 9001 for quality management and WRAP for social compliance.

blocks.heading: From Pattern to Bulk: Steps, Timing and Terms

items.heading: Starting quantities
paragraphs: Orders start at 50 pieces per style in each colour. That gives small and growing labels a place to start production.

items.heading: Trial runs
paragraphs: We agree your first trial quantity with you case by case. How far we can adjust it depends on production requirements.

items.heading: Bulk timing
paragraphs: Bulk production takes 35 to 40 days once you've approved the sample and we've received your deposit. Your order size and the season set where you fall in that range.

items.heading: Production payments
paragraphs: You pay a 50% deposit when you confirm your order and the other 50% before we ship the goods.

items.heading: Shipping terms
paragraphs: You can choose FOB, CIF or DDP. With worldwide DDP you get one all-in price delivered to your door, and we handle duties, customs and freight through our forwarding partners.

items.heading: Fabric sourcing
paragraphs: Our [Fabric sourcing](/swimwear-fabrics-sourcing/) covers 80% nylon/20% spandex as well as your own textiles. If you supply fabric, give us the mill name or code. We report any shortages or defects within 3 business days, before cutting. If our error causes damage beyond the 5% overage, we pay you back at the documented purchase cost.

items.heading: Custom printing
paragraphs: Our in-factory [Custom Printing service](/custom-swimwear-printing/) prints stocked fabrics the same day. Standard jobs take 2–3 days after you approve the artwork, and a full print run is finished within 2.5 weeks, inside the 35 to 40 days of bulk production. You approve the print by video or with a physical strike-off on your fabric.

items.heading: Swimwear hardware
paragraphs: Our [Swimwear Hardware service](/swimwear-hardware/) supplies branded metal fittings that resist salt water and chlorine. Standard hardware starts at 100 to 500 pieces per colour or size. Logo or embossed stoppers, clasps, hooks, sliders and rings, and special finishes, start at 1,000 pieces per item.

blocks.heading: Samples First: Lead Time and Fees

items.heading: Sample timing and cost
items.text: We make a standard sample in 10 to 15 days. Each sample you order costs USD 50.

items.heading: Starter pack for new labels
items.text: Our starter pack gives you three finished samples, twenty fabric swatches, a catalogue of the ready-made styles we keep in stock and a short guide to launching your swimwear brand.

items.heading: Design fees
items.text: The design fee is USD 50 per design, whether it's a pattern or a print, and it covers all colourways. We don't refund sample or design fees or credit them against bulk orders.

items.heading: Courier and inspections
items.text: Under our [sample delivery and inspection terms](/faq/), you pay USD 50 for courier delivery on top of the sample fees. Independent pre-shipment inspectors such as SGS or BV are welcome.

items.heading: Quotation first
items.text: Send us complete designs, meaning front and back images, tech packs or clear line drawings. We'll give you a [sampling-to-shipping quotation](/request-a-quote/) within 2 to 3 working days, and sampling starts once we've agreed the price.

blocks.heading: Launch Photography Shot From Your Own Samples

items.heading: Samples to shoot
paragraphs: Your samples go straight from our factory to the shoot, so your images are finished before your bulk stock arrives.

items.heading: Campaign and product images
paragraphs: On set, our partner photography team styles and shoots your collection for editorial campaign images, clean product photographs and close-up details for your online store, and we coordinate the shoot.

items.heading: Consistent product pages
paragraphs: You can choose on-model, flat-lay or ghost-mannequin formats, or combine them. Pair your on-model campaigns with one white-background product format per category, and your store imagery stays consistent.

items.heading: Locations and casting
paragraphs: Our partner team shoots in a Guangzhou studio or at a beach or pool chosen for your collection, and casts professional models, including plus-size models for 2XL samples and child models for kids’ swimwear.

items.heading: Live shoot approval
paragraphs: You can attend the shoot in person or follow it over a live video link, and you approve the images as they are taken.

items.heading: Sample sizes and quantities
paragraphs: Shoots use size M, or 2XL for plus-size styles, using 1 piece per style and colour per model. If a style is shown on two models together, we need a second piece.

items.heading: Your samples returned
paragraphs: The shoot samples stay yours, and we ship them back to you with your completed bulk order.

blocks.heading: True Colour, Finished Images and Shoot Pricing

items.heading: Approved colour reference
items.text: You approve each physical fabric colour under daylight. We then match every image to that swatch using a colour reference card and daylight-balanced lighting.

items.heading: Faithful retouching
items.text: We only remove dust, lint and temporary marks. Retouching never changes the fabric texture, coverage, cut or fit on the body.

items.heading: Image files and crops
items.text: For each style, you get 3 retouched images per look as high-resolution JPEGs at 4000 px on the long edge, along with web-optimised versions and 1:1, 4:5 and 2:3 crops.

items.heading: Proofs and final delivery
items.text: We send you proofs within 3 business days of the shoot and deliver your final retouched images within 10 business days.

items.heading: Shoot pricing
items.text: Your photo and film price depends on the number of styles, looks, models, locations, shoot days and retouched images, plus the length and number of video edits.

items.heading: Agreement before booking
items.text: Before we book any shoot or film work, we agree your project’s dates, deliverables and price with you.

blocks.heading: Launch Film Cut for Social and Your Store
paragraphs: We plan your film and stills together and set aside time to capture movement, stretch and fit both in the water and on land.

items.heading: Shared shoot production
paragraphs: The same partner crew films alongside your stills at the same locations, and edits the footage for your store and social channels.

items.heading: Launch film formats
paragraphs: You can choose a hero campaign cut for launch and paid media, vertical reels and stories, and product motion clips that show movement and fit.

items.heading: Branding and captions
paragraphs: We add logo intros, end cards and lower thirds in your brand fonts and colours, with captions either burned in or supplied as separate SRT files.

items.heading: English voiceover
paragraphs: You get a professional English voiceover, recorded by our partner voice artists from the script you approve, and you can pick from 2 voices for your film.

items.heading: Translated video versions
paragraphs: Each edit can have up to 5 language versions, including Spanish, French, German, Japanese or Arabic. You approve the translations in a text file before we add subtitles and on-screen text.

items.heading: Paid media use
paragraphs: The music is commercially licensed for paid social and search advertising, and you can use your final edits with no time or territory limit.

items.heading: Raw footage handover
paragraphs: If you ask for it, we hand over your raw footage as a file download within 5 business days of final delivery.

blocks.heading: Brand Identity: Logo Marks, Colours and Typography

items.heading: Logo marks for garments
paragraphs: We start by designing your logo to work very small and in one colour on woven labels, hang tags and hygiene liners, and then we settle its full-colour screen version.

items.heading: Identity beyond the logo
paragraphs: Alongside your logo marks, we develop your colour palette and typography, with guidelines that show you how to use the identity across labels, tags and screens.

items.heading: Packaging and supplied labels
paragraphs: [Swimwear Packaging & Custom Brand Labels](/swimwear-packaging-custom-brand-labels/) uses marked, retail-ready 5-ply export cartons. If you supply your own labels, tags or bags, send 3% extra at least 7 days before cutting. We check them when they arrive and report any shortages or defects within 3 business days, before cutting.

blocks.heading: An Online Store Ready on Launch Day
paragraphs: We build and set up your online store, lay out its product pages and place your images. Then we hand it over to you to own and run. Every swimwear product page is built around fit, with a clear size guide, the size the model is wearing, the fabric composition, coverage and care notes.

blocks.heading: Your Launch Step by Step, From Brief to Go-Live
paragraphs: We invoice launch services separately from production: half when you book and half on delivery of the finished work, by T/T in USD or EUR.

steps.heading: Share your brief
steps.text: Send us your brand name, market, mood board, style images or tech packs, fabrics, collection size, quantities, branding needs, budget and shipping destination. If you don't have any assets yet, your brand name and a few reference pictures are enough to get started.

steps.heading: Agree your plan
steps.text: We [reply to your enquiry](/contact-us/) within one business day. Then we work out which launch services your project needs and quote them separately from production.

steps.heading: Make and brand
steps.text: Branding runs alongside sampling and takes 2 to 3 weeks. We finalise it during sampling, so your labels, tags and packaging are ready for bulk production.

steps.heading: Shoot approved samples
steps.text: Your photo and video shoot takes 1 to 2 weeks. It happens during bulk production and uses the samples you've approved.

steps.heading: Build during production
steps.text: Your store build takes 2 to 3 weeks. It also runs during bulk production, alongside the work of getting your collection ready for launch.

steps.heading: Complete your launch
steps.text: Allow about 10 to 12 weeks from brief to launch across all six stages. We fit sampling, branding, the shoot and the store work around production.

blocks.heading: What buyers say

items.quote: We were nervous about ordering our very first bikinis, but the team made the whole thing feel manageable. They gave us a clear quote before anything else, then made a sample so we could check the fit and feel before committing. Starting at 50 pieces per style in each colour meant we didn't have to gamble on a mountain of stock. The fabric feels soft but supportive, and the stitching is really neat. We'd happily recommend them to anyone just getting started!
items.author: Founder, independent bikini label, Australia

items.quote: Building our first swimwear collection went far more smoothly than we expected. We sent rough front and back sketches, and their in-house design team took care of the patterns and graded every style from XS to 2X. Whenever a detail needed our input, they followed up quickly by email or phone. We never felt our ideas were being watered down. The finished pieces hold their shape beautifully, and the workmanship is consistent across the whole range.
items.author: Co-founder, resortwear brand, Canada

blocks.heading: Related products and services
Frequently Asked Questions

items.question: Can you shoot or build a store for swimwear I already have from another supplier, or only for styles you manufacture?
items.answer: We work with swimwear from other suppliers as well as the styles we make. You can book photography, film, branding or a store build on its own, with no package or garment order needed. Send us the service you want and the materials you already have, and we'll explain what the project needs. If we manufacture your collection, we build the store around your styles, your identity and your campaign images.

items.question: What revision rounds are included for the photos and films, and which changes would require a new shoot rather than an edit?
items.answer: Photo retouching comes with 2 revision rounds, and so does every film or video edit. These rounds cover colour, image selection, crops, cut order, timing, captions and music. Please put your team's feedback together in one list for each round. New models, new locations, new styling, styles that weren't in the shoot and fresh angles all need a new shoot. Branding comes with 2 logo concepts and 1 revision round on the concept you pick. Store builds come with 2 rounds of changes before handover.

items.question: What usage rights do I receive for the photos and videos, including model releases and any music licences, across my store, advertising and retailer channels?
items.answer: Once you've paid, you get unlimited commercial rights to the final photos and videos. You can use them in your store, on your social channels, in paid advertising and with retail or wholesale partners, with no time or territory limits. Before every shoot, our partner photography team collects signed model releases that cover all of these uses. The only music we use is royalty-free and licensed for commercial and paid social use.

items.question: Is the launch service meant for new founders only, or can an established label use it for a new swim line?
items.answer: It's for both new founders and established labels. Founders without assets can book the full package, from brief to launch. Established labels adding swimwear can pick individual services. Either way, one team runs your development, sampling and production and coordinates your launch.

items.question: Does the launch step include advertising setup, campaign management or social publishing, or does your service end with delivering the assets and store?
items.answer: Our service ends when we hand over your finished assets and your store is ready to take orders. We don't do advertising setup, campaign management or social publishing. You or your marketing team handle those with the files we deliver.

items.question: What decides how much a full launch costs, and which choices make it more or less expensive?
items.answer: Each shoot, film, branding and store package is priced per project, and the total moves with your number of styles, shoot locations and models, photos and film edits, video length, branding scope, packaging items and store complexity. Production costs follow design complexity, fabric choice, quantity and whether you choose custom designs or catalogue styles. Send us your styles and the services you want, and we quote production within 2 to 3 working days, with launch services quoted separately.

items.question: Will one person manage my whole launch across production, the shoot and the store?
items.answer: When you enquire, we assign you a dedicated swimwear specialist. That person is your one contact for production, photography, branding and the store. A merchandiser tracks sampling and bulk production and sends you photo updates at every stage. You also deal directly with our design and production teams, with no agents in between.

seo.title: About Us: Our Own Factory in Guangzhou | Strandmill
seo.description: Work directly with your swimwear factory. Strandmill owns its Guangzhou factory, with design, sampling, production and export handled under one roof.

hero.heading: About Us: Strandmill's Own Guangzhou Factory
lead: We cut, sew and check your swimwear under one roof in Guangzhou, with no middlemen.

cta.label: Contact us

blocks.heading: What We Make In-House and How Much Each Month
paragraphs: We make about 100,000 swimwear pieces a month in bulk, so we take on everything from small runs to large-volume orders. Our 65-person sampling studio works alongside the bulk lines and turns out about 55 custom samples a day. That gives your collection its own development capacity.

blocks.heading: Our Story: One Guangzhou Factory Since 2011
paragraphs: We've made swimwear in our own single factory in Guangzhou, Guangdong, China, since 2011. We're one company that owns its factory and runs both production and export, so quality, cost and delivery stay under our direct control.

blocks.heading: The Brands We Work With Directly
paragraphs: Every year we make samples and bulk orders for more than 350 brands, with design, production and private labelling for clients from small businesses to large enterprises.

items.heading: First-time and emerging brands
paragraphs: If you're a founder, we help you turn your ideas into specifications. We work with private-label start-ups and with emerging bikini labels that are planning seasonal online launches.

items.heading: Established and apparel labels
paragraphs: We produce to your tech packs. We work with swimwear, resort, fashion and activewear labels, and with boutique and apparel brands.

items.heading: Retail and trade buyers
paragraphs: E-commerce swim and sports labels, online retailers, wholesalers and importers work with us on their sampling and bulk orders.

items.heading: Specialist organisations
paragraphs: We also manufacture for swim schools, surf shops, lifeguard programmes, resorts and event organisers who buy directly from our factory.

items.heading: Direct business orders
paragraphs: We sell B2B only, through this website and our team, and we agree every order directly. We don't have an online shop, a third-party marketplace or a platform store.

blocks.heading: Everything Under One Roof, From Pattern to Carton
paragraphs: The pattern maker and team who make your sample also make its bulk adjustments. That way one team handles fit corrections from the first pattern to the sealed carton. Design development, digital patterning, sampling, printing, embroidery, cutting, sewing, finishing and packing all happen in our own factory, and no production stage goes to an outside workshop. Fabric, hardware and trims come from our long-term suppliers, and freight and lab tests run through our partners.
When you buy from us, you buy from the factory that sews your swimwear.

blocks.heading: Order Minimums for Small and Growing Labels
paragraphs: Orders start at 50 pieces per style in each colour. For your first trial order, we agree the quantity with you case by case, within our production limits.

Small or complex runs go on flexible setups, and high-volume repeat styles go on dedicated bulk lines. Our experienced technicians run modern, automated cutting and sewing machinery around the clock, including flatlock machines and sublimation printers. Production follows ethical labour standards. If you're an established label, you get dedicated project management.

blocks.heading: How an Order Moves From Sample to Shipment
paragraphs: [OEM and ODM development](/development/) starts from your design or idea; samples take 10 to 15 days and cost USD 50 plus USD 50 a design.

steps.heading: Final sample approval
steps.text: You approve the final sample in the actual bulk fabric, colour and print. That signed-off piece becomes the sealed production reference.

steps.heading: Order confirmation
steps.text: We take a 50% deposit when you confirm your order. Bulk production starts once you've approved the sample and we've received that deposit.

steps.heading: Bulk production
steps.text: Bulk production takes 35 to 40 days. Your order size and the season set the exact timing.

steps.heading: Reference-led production
steps.text: Cutting, stitching, assembly and finishing follow the approved sample under controlled production standards. We check fit, construction and finish the whole way through, and sizing stays consistent across repeat orders.

steps.heading: Balance payment
steps.text: You pay the remaining 50% before shipment, so your confirmed order is fully paid before the goods leave.

steps.heading: Shipment terms
steps.text: We ship FOB, CIF or DDP. With worldwide DDP you get one all-in price for delivery to your door, and we handle duties, customs and freight through our forwarding partners.

blocks.heading: How We Check Quality at Every Stage

items.heading: Checks throughout production
items.text: Our structured QC system covers incoming fabric, cutting and sewing. We also run random checks and finish with a full final inspection.

items.heading: Every piece inspected
items.text: Before packing, we check every bulk piece for measurements, size tolerance, symmetry, seam strength and comfort, stretch recovery, colour consistency, print clarity, and wires and straps.

items.heading: Agreed inspection criteria
items.text: We inspect bulk against your approved sample and the tolerances we've agreed with you in writing. Before shipment, we send you the final inspection report so you can decide whether to release the goods.

items.heading: Consistent bulk finish
items.text: Every piece gets export-standard stitching and finishing, whatever the size of your order. We check that colour stays uniform across the whole run and matches across fabric, lining and trims.

items.heading: Materials and results
items.text: We use quality yarn and fabric, aim for zero defects on every order and keep our qualification rate above 99%.

items.heading: Experienced inspection team
items.text: Our dedicated QC team has more than 10 years of inspection experience and oversees every run. If you ask, they'll provide remote quality checks, video inspections or goods presentations.

blocks.heading: Certifications and Compliance Paperwork
paragraphs: We ask for your target market when we quote. That way we pick fabrics, trims, labels and tests that meet its rules from the start.

items.heading: Certifications held
items.text: Our production holds OEKO-TEX Standard 100 for tested fabrics and trims, GRS and RCS for recycled fabrics, bluesign for chemistry, ISO 9001 for quality management and WRAP for social compliance. We're also audited under amfori BSCI.

items.heading: Market safety requirements
items.text: Order-specific lab tests at cost cover GB 18401, REACH, CPSIA, CCPSA or SASO. Every stage, from fabric to finished garment, follows international quality-system certification standards.

items.heading: Market compliance paperwork
items.text: We give you complete paperwork and test reports to support your market's regulations. Our paperwork and order-specific test reports back shipments to Australia, the EU, the US, the Middle East and other regions.

blocks.heading: Frequently Asked Questions

items.question: How quickly will someone reply to my message, and is it slower on weekends or holidays?
items.answer: We reply within one business day, and our business days run Monday to Saturday. Sunday falls outside our working week. If you send a message during a Chinese public holiday, we answer it within one business day of our return. Our factory closes for about 3 weeks over Chinese New Year and for 7 days during National Day week (1 to 7 October), and production timelines move back by the same amount of time. If you need bulk shipment before Chinese New Year, place your order at least 8 weeks before the holiday. If you approve just before a closure, your delivery is delayed by more than the approval time itself.

items.question: Which time zone are you in, and what are your working hours?
items.answer: We work on China Standard Time (UTC+8), Monday to Saturday, from 9:00 to 18:00. If you write outside those hours, we reply within one business day. To get the fastest answers, send key decisions during our working hours in China.

items.question: Which languages can I write to you in?
items.answer: You can write to us in English or Chinese. If you write in any other language, we reply in English, and we keep quotations, tech packs and order documents in English. When you confirm key decisions in writing in English, everything you've agreed stays documented.

items.question: Can I visit your office or showroom in person, and where is it?
items.answer: You can visit our own factory in Guangzhou, Guangdong, China, during development or mass production. Our sample room displays in-stock styles and fabric swatches. Book at least 5 business days ahead by email or WhatsApp. If you can't travel, we show you the production floor on a live video call instead.

blocks.heading: Related pages
Our Background & How We Sell

items.question: Do you sell to brands that hold their own stock, or do you dropship?
items.answer: We sell only to brands that hold and ship their own stock, so your warehouse or third-party fulfilment partner needs to be ready before delivery. We don't dropship, and we don't fulfil marketplace or web-store orders.

items.question: Can I buy from an online shop or marketplace store of yours?
items.answer: No. We sell only through our website and our own team. We have no online or marketplace shop, and we agree every order with you directly. Our [factory background](/about-us/) goes back to 2011.

items.question: Can you put me in touch with one of your existing clients?
items.answer: We keep our private-label clients anonymous, so a reference needs that client's written consent. If they consent, you get the reference within 5 business days of your request. While you wait, we offer you our catalogue and available garments from earlier production runs, so you can handle and test them yourself.

blocks.heading: OEM, ODM & Design Confidentiality

items.question: Will you sign an NDA before we send our design files?
items.answer: Yes. If you need an NDA or cooperation agreement first, tell us in your first message, and we sign it before you send any files. We keep those files restricted to your company account, and we protect your designs, prints, patterns, brand and ideas.

items.question: Will you use our patterns for other clients or reveal our brand?
items.answer: No. We use the patterns you supply only for your company, and we never reveal your brand without your approval. We also keep our private-label clients anonymous.

items.question: Do you offer both OEM and ODM development for new styles?
items.answer: Yes. A style can start from your own design, a picture or just an idea. Our in-house team handles pattern design, grading and fit development, which cuts down the design back-and-forth.

blocks.heading: Stock Styles & Wholesale Buying

items.question: Do you keep any swimwear styles in stock for wholesale buyers?
items.answer: Yes. As well as making to order, we keep some styles in stock for wholesale buyers. Send your enquiry through the form on our website or by email, and we agree every order with you directly.

items.question: Can I check fabric and fit before I brand your ready-made styles?
items.answer: Yes. Before you pick ready-to-brand styles, you can check fabric hand-feel and fit on up to three garments from earlier runs. Any preprinted samples we have ship within 1 to 2 business days.

blocks.heading: Pricing & Quotes

items.question: Do you publish prices, and what do you need to quote a style?
items.answer: We don't publish prices online. We quote each style from your spec sheets, detailed photos or reference images. With our [quotation process](/request-a-quote/), we agree the price with you before we make your sample, so you know your cost before sampling starts.

items.question: Which choices set the unit price of my swimwear?
items.answer: Your price rests on the style's complexity, coverage, fabric, lining, print method and any custom printing, plus your labels, branding, packaging and order quantity. We confirm bulk pricing once we've reviewed your design and the fabric you've chosen.

items.question: Do larger orders get a lower price per piece?
items.answer: Yes. The more pieces you order, the lower your per-unit cost, and that includes custom embroidered pieces. For 3,000 pieces or more, you get a custom quote at our best pricing. Because you deal directly with our production floor, private-label and wholesale orders are priced at factory level.

blocks.heading: Fabrics & Materials

items.question: Which swimwear fabrics do you work with, and what can you source on request?
items.answer: Our [swimwear fabrics and sourcing](/swimwear-fabrics-sourcing/) range covers nylon or polyester blended with spandex, including 80% nylon / 20% spandex with matching linings. On request, we also source chlorine-resistant LYCRA Xtra Life, recycled ECONYL nylon, recycled REPREVE polyester and Italian Carvico fabrics.

visuals.purpose: Shows the fibre make-up of a typical swimwear fabric blend.

blocks.heading: Samples: Timing, Fees & Delivery

items.question: How long does a sample take, and how is it delivered?
items.answer: Your standard sample takes 10 to 15 days to make. DHL then delivers it to your door in 5 to 7 days. We quote first, and sampling starts once you agree the price.

items.question: What do samples cost, and are the fees refunded against bulk?
items.answer: Each sample costs USD 50, plus a USD 50 design fee per design that covers its pattern or print in all colourways. Courier delivery is another USD 50. Neither the sample fee nor the design fee is refunded or credited against your bulk order.

visuals.purpose: Shows how long sample making and DHL delivery take, so buyers can plan sample approval.
visuals.caption: Sample timing

visuals.purpose: Shows the sample-stage fees, none of which are refunded or credited against the bulk order.
visuals.caption: Sample-stage fees (not refunded or credited)

blocks.heading: Minimum Order Quantities

items.question: What is your minimum order quantity for swimwear?
items.answer: Swimwear orders start at 50 pieces per style in each colour. That suits small and growing labels launching a capsule or testing their market. We agree first-trial quantities with you case by case, within our production limits.

items.question: Can I split the minimum across sizes, and how do bikinis count?
items.answer: Yes. You can split each style-and-colour minimum across 3 to 4 sizes. A bikini top and its bottom together count as one piece toward the minimum.

items.question: Do fabric minimums or special finishes change the garment minimum?
items.answer: Imported or custom-dyed fabrics carry their own mill minimums in metres, which we check before costing. The garment minimum stays 50 pieces per style in each colour, even when a piece has embroidery, special washes, unusual construction, mixed fabrics and prints, or private-label details.

items.question: Do matching accessories and ready-made styles have their own minimums?
items.answer: Bucket hats, scrunchies and headbands also start at 50 pieces per style per colour, cut from your swimwear fabric or print. You can order our ready-made designs without a tech pack, and matching couple sets also start at a low minimum.

blocks.heading: Order Sizes, Mixed Sizes and Colours

items.question: Can I mix sizes and colours within one order?
items.answer: Yes. You can mix sizes and colours within one order, and we pack your size split at no extra cost, including mixed age ratios for children's swimwear. Your quantities decide which styles we combine.

items.question: Which size ratio do you use for a standard carton?
items.answer: Our S:M:L:XL ratio is 1:2:2:1, for example 2 S, 4 M, 4 L and 2 XL. If you order each size in multiples of 5 or 6, your cartons pack evenly. For a larger-size assortment, we propose 4 each of L, XL and 2XL per carton.

items.question: Do you take small batches as well as large retail programmes?
items.answer: Yes. We take on boutique batches, small team orders and large retail programmes, and your sizing stays consistent as your volumes grow. We plan production around your requirements.

blocks.heading: Bulk Production Lead Times

items.question: How long does bulk production take after sample approval?
items.answer: Once you approve the sample and we receive your deposit, bulk production usually takes 35 to 40 days, depending on order size and season. We confirm your exact lead time with the order, based on your signed-off sample and specifications.

items.question: What else can lengthen the bulk production lead time?
items.answer: Beyond order size and season, timing depends on design complexity, sample revisions, material availability, washing, customisation, our production schedule and holidays. If you lock your specifications early and allow time for fabric sourcing and holidays, all of this fits into your launch plan.

visuals.purpose: Shows what must happen before bulk starts and how long bulk usually takes.
visuals.caption: From sign-off to bulk production

blocks.heading: Order Confirmation & Scheduling

items.question: What do we agree before you confirm my bulk order?
items.answer: Before you confirm the order, our sales team goes over price, quantity and delivery time with you and gives you a detailed production schedule. Once your sample is approved, we confirm specifications, colours, size ratio, packaging, quantity and schedule with you before bulk starts.

items.question: Can I change my order after it has been confirmed?
items.answer: Your approved sample and confirmed specification sheet are the only references we use for bulk. Any change after confirmation becomes a revision with a new schedule. We handle purchase orders strictly in the order we receive them.

items.question: How will I know if my delivery date is at risk?
items.answer: Our merchandisers track progress against your confirmed delivery date. If a delay comes up, they tell you within 2 business days, so you can plan around it.

blocks.heading: Priority & Rush Orders

items.question: Can you take a rush order for a time-critical launch?
items.answer: We accept a rush order when the product, quantity, artwork and our available workload capacity allow it. We quote the surcharge as a percentage of order value; you pay it in full with your 50% deposit. If you produce with us every month, you get scheduling priority, and an early forecast lets us book your production slot instead of relying on rush production.

blocks.heading: Repeat Orders & Restocks

items.question: How long does a repeat order of an approved style take?
items.answer: Approved repeat styles skip sampling: bulk takes 35 to 40 days after deposit, and a style needing a new mould or print adds 2 to 3 weeks. We keep your approved designs, patterns, artwork and production specifications, so your restocks match earlier deliveries. Reorder under the same style references and list any changes in writing. We store leftover components free and use them first on your next run.

blocks.heading: Quality Control & Inspections

items.question: How do you check quality while my order is in production?
items.answer: Quality is checked at every stage of your order. We check your incoming fabric, then cutting and sewing, then run random checks and a full final inspection before your order ships.

items.question: Can we send our own inspector, such as SGS or BV?
items.answer: Yes. Before shipment, you can inspect the goods yourself or appoint an independent inspector such as SGS or BV. Book any third-party inspection before you pay the balance, and agree the inspection standard and checklist with us in advance.

blocks.heading: Test Reports & Certifications

items.question: Which certifications does your swimwear production hold?
items.answer: Our [production certifications](/sustainability/) cover OEKO-TEX Standard 100 for tested fabrics and trims, GRS and RCS for recycled fabrics, bluesign for chemistry, ISO 9001 for quality management and WRAP for social compliance.

items.question: Do your test reports cover my specific styles?
items.answer: Our available reports name the fabric, trim or hardware that was tested. They don't cover your specific style unless that style was tested. When your ordered styles, colours and trims need reports, we arrange testing at an accredited lab and share the results before bulk. Lab fees are charged at cost on your balance invoice.

blocks.heading: Payment Terms & Shipping Options

items.question: What are your payment terms for bulk orders?
items.answer: You pay a 50% deposit when you confirm your order and the other 50% before we ship, both by T/T bank transfer in USD or EUR. Put your order number in the transfer reference, and once you've paid, send us the bank remittance slip.

items.question: Can I pay for samples and courier charges by PayPal?
items.answer: Yes. For samples and courier charges, you can also pay by PayPal. Deposits and balances on bulk orders are paid by T/T bank transfer in USD or EUR.

visuals.purpose: Shows how the order value is split between the deposit and the balance.
visuals.caption: Payment split

items.question: Which shipping terms do you offer, and is DDP available worldwide?
items.answer: We ship on FOB, CIF or DDP terms, and our DDP service covers destinations worldwide. Under DDP, you pay one all-in price for delivery to your door, and we handle the duties, customs and freight for you through our forwarding partners.

items.question: Can you arrange the freight, or can I use my own forwarder?
items.answer: Both work. We can book shipping through our forwarding partners, or you can arrange it yourself. Freight pricing depends on your destination and order size, so ask for freight alongside your goods quote to get the full delivered cost and see who pays each charge under the delivery terms we agree.

items.question: Which shipping modes and carriers do you use for orders?
items.answer: We measure your packed cartons, then choose sea, air, rail or express based on actual weight, volume and urgency. Our planning guide puts air express quickest below 100 kg and sea freight economical at around 300 kg. We ship by express carriers such as DHL and FedEx, and regularly to the US, EU, UK and Australia.

items.question: When do I get the tracking link for a courier shipment?
items.answer: We email you the courier tracking link within a few hours of collection, so you can follow your goods from the moment the carrier picks them up.

blocks.heading: Customs & Export Documents

items.question: Which customs and export documents do you prepare for my shipment?
items.answer: Our shipping department handles the customs declaration, and for a bulk order, declaration plus dispatch takes 4 to 7 days. We prepare your commercial invoice, packing list, certificate of origin and the other customs documents your shipment requires, including compliance paperwork for children's products when your order needs it. Send us your consignee details and certificate requirements before dispatch.

blocks.heading: Dispatch & Delivery to Your Door

items.question: Can you deliver straight to our port, address or fulfilment centre?
items.answer: Yes. Before we pack, confirm your discharge port, delivery address or fulfilment centre, so the carton labels, marks and pallet builds meet your receiver's requirements. We film-wrap your cartons, dispatch straight from our factory on the schedule you agreed, give you an estimated delivery timeline and track every shipment through to arrival.

We film-wrap your cartons, dispatch straight from our factory on the schedule you agreed, give you an estimated delivery timeline and track every shipment through to arrival.

Frequently Asked Questions

items.question: Can you show examples of swimwear you've made for brands selling in Europe or North America?
items.answer: Yes. Every year we make samples and bulk orders for more than 350 brands, and some of those labels sell in Europe and North America. Here are three recent projects, with client names kept private. A start-up bikini label in the United States came to us with sketches and a mood board for its first collection. Our in-house design team turned them into patterns graded from XS to XL, and the fit samples were ready in 10 to 15 days. The label launched six styles at our 50-piece minimum per style in each colour, shipped them DDP to its warehouse and reordered its two best sellers the next season. A swim school in Canada needed chlorine-resistant training suits in its club colours, with its logo printed and sizes from children's to adult. We matched the club colours to its Pantone references, sublimated the logo on chlorine-resistant polyester and packed mixed sizes in each carton at no extra cost. Bulk took 35 to 40 days after sample approval, and the approved style now repeats without a new sample. A plus-size swimwear label in Germany moved a range to us after cups gaped and straps dug in on its previous factory's run. We redrafted the styles on a 2XL base, wet-tested the samples on a 2XL fit model and graded them up to 5XL. An SGS inspector checked the bulk before shipment, and the label relaunched the range the following season. For those markets, we hold OEKO-TEX Standard 100, GRS, RCS, bluesign, ISO 9001 and WRAP, with amfori BSCI audits. Our forwarding partners ship FOB, CIF or DDP. If your market requires test reports for the styles you order, we have those styles tested at an accredited lab, and the lab fees go on your balance invoice at cost.

items.question: Have you ever taken over a production that went wrong at another factory, and what did you do?
items.answer: Yes. When we take over a run that went wrong at another factory, we find the fault and get a corrected sample approved before bulk production starts again. Most failed runs come from mistakes in the pattern, grading or fit, not from the sewing. If we produce again from the same faulty pattern, the defect comes back at our factory too. Switching factories doesn't fix it on its own. Send us your approved sample or tech pack along with a few of the faulty pieces, and we'll reply within one business day. After we agree on the price, our in-house design team fixes the pattern, grading and fit and makes a new sample in 10 to 15 days. Bulk production then takes 35 to 40 days from when you approve the sample and we receive your deposit, depending on order size and season. The extra sample round means delivery takes longer than just re-running the order. If the original fault was clearly in the fabric or trims and not the fit, that extra round adds little. We also accept fabric and trims you've already bought for the order. We inspect them when they arrive and tell you about any shortages or defects within 3 business days, before cutting.

items.question: Have you worked with small start-up brands placing their first order, like us?
items.answer: Yes. We work with new labels on their first order, and we offer a starter pack and separate startup packages for your first collection. The starter pack contains three finished samples, twenty fabric swatches, a catalogue of the ready-made styles we keep in stock and a short guide to launching your own swimwear brand. The startup packages cover design, development and manufacturing. Many new labels combine these packages with our consulting service. The starter pack and the startup packages are offered separately.

items.question: Can I speak to one of the brands you've worked with as a reference?
items.answer: Yes, but only once that client has given written consent. When they do, we put you in touch within 5 business days of your request. We keep our private-label clients anonymous, and that includes brands whose failed production runs we've taken over. So we never share a reference contact without permission. In the meantime, we can send you our catalogue and up to three garments from earlier production runs within 1 to 2 business days, depending on availability.

seo.title: Sustainability: Recycled Swim Fabrics | Strandmill
seo.description: Recycled ECONYL and REPREVE fabrics, GRS, RCS, OEKO-TEX and bluesign certification, and batch transaction certificates for your recycled-content claims.

hero.heading: Sustainability at Strandmill
lead: We help you choose recycled materials that look, stretch and wear the way your designs need.

cta.label: Request a quote

blocks.heading: Recycled Fabrics and Low-Impact Production
paragraphs: We start by matching recycled fabrics to the stretch, hand feel, print and colour your swimwear needs. Then we source options that suit your design and budget.

items.heading: Regenerated Fibre Performance
paragraphs: Waste such as plastic items and old carpets is cleaned, sorted, liquefied and reformed, then made into fabric. Regenerated fibre performs much like new fibre. Any difference in performance comes from the fibre type and the way the fabric is constructed, not from the fibre being recycled.

items.heading: Sustainable Fabric Choices
paragraphs: On request, we source ECONYL regenerated nylon, including Italian Carvico ECONYL fabrics, REPREVE recycled polyester and 84/16 recycled polyester-spandex. For cotton pieces, we also offer organic cotton from GOTS- or OCS-certified mills.

items.heading: Requested Fabrics And Trade-offs
paragraphs: If you ask, we source imported GRS- or OEKO-TEX-certified recycled fabrics, regenerated Lycra, and waste-regenerated fabrics coloured with OEKO-TEX-certified dyes. Branded or imported certified options cost more and come in fewer colours with less stock, so a tight budget or deadline narrows your choice.

items.heading: Swimwear Fabric Construction
paragraphs: We make your swimwear in nylon or polyester blended with spandex, such as 80% nylon 20% spandex, with matching linings. Chlorine-resistant LYCRA Xtra Life is available if you ask for it.

items.heading: Production And Waste
paragraphs: We manage production waste strictly, and leftover fabric and components stay in our warehouse for your next run. Choosing recycled polyester helps your line cut plastic waste.

items.heading: Animal-free Production
paragraphs: Our process involves no animal testing, and on request we make vegan swimwear your brand can submit for PETA's 'Cruelty Free' and 'PETA-Approved Vegan' logos.

items.heading: Retail-ready Packaging Service
paragraphs: Through our [Swimwear Packaging & Custom Brand Labels](/swimwear-packaging-custom-brand-labels/) service, you get retail-ready, industrially compostable packaging, branded accessories and logos heat-pressed inside, plus optional cardboard tags, connectors and individual hand-wrapping. We source labels and packaging through our trim suppliers.

items.heading: Sample Development Costs
paragraphs: A standard [development sample](/development/) is ready in 10 to 15 days and costs USD 50 each. On top of that, you pay USD 50 per design, meaning each pattern or print, with all its colourways included. Neither fee is refunded or credited against your bulk order.

blocks.heading: Our Certifications, Audits and Transaction Certificates
paragraphs: Our [ordering terms](/faq/) start at 50 pieces per style in each colour, with 35 to 40 days of bulk production and FOB, CIF or DDP shipping.

items.heading: Production Standards
items.text: We hold OEKO-TEX Standard 100 for tested fabrics and trims, bluesign for chemistry, ISO 9001 for quality management and WRAP for social compliance.

items.heading: Fabric-specific Certification
items.text: We hold GRS and RCS for recycled fabrics, and we supply GRS documentation, including for recycled polyester. Certified options are available on request, and your fabric determines which certificates apply.

items.heading: Shipment-level Recycled Claims
items.text: If your order uses GRS- or RCS-certified fabric, ask for a transaction certificate when you confirm the order. We then apply for the shipment-specific evidence of recycled-content percentage that retailers and labelling rules require. This goes beyond what mill certificates show.

items.heading: Transaction Certificate Costs
items.text: We pass on the certification body's fee at cost on your balance invoice. The extra paperwork takes time, so if your line makes no recycled-content claims, you don't need to pay for this.

items.heading: Fibre-brand Trademark Approval
items.text: Before you put ECONYL or REPREVE hangtags and logos on your labels, the fibre brand has to give trademark approval. Starting early gives the approval time to come through, and we provide the mill application documents.

items.heading: Certificate Copies
items.text: Our factory is audited under amfori BSCI. When you ask, we email you certificate copies within 1 business day, each showing the certificate number and validity date.

items.heading: Buyer-appointed Factory Audits
items.text: We accept factory and social-compliance audits by any auditor you appoint, as long as you give us 14 days' notice. You pay the audit fee.

items.heading: Audit Summary Access
items.text: Under an NDA, we share summaries of our latest WRAP and BSCI audits with you.

Frequently Asked Questions

items.question: Can you measure the carbon footprint of our order and share it with us?
items.answer: Yes, we can prepare a carbon footprint estimate per piece and for your whole bulk swimwear order. It covers fabric, the energy used for cutting and sewing in our factory, packaging, and freight to your destination under your FOB, CIF or DDP terms. We calculate it with GHG Protocol emission factors, and we use fabric mill data wherever the mill provides it. You get a PDF report within 10 business days after shipment. Please note that this is our own calculation, not a figure verified by an outside party.

items.question: Can you take back fabric offcuts or old swimwear for recycling?
items.answer: Yes. We sort the nylon, polyester and spandex offcuts from your orders by fibre and send them to a textile recycling partner, who turns them into fibre or filling. If you ask, we report the recycled weight for each order. We also take old swimwear from your brand's collection programme. It has to arrive at our factory in batches of at least 20 kg, and we pass it on to the same recycling partner.

items.question: Do you use plastic-free or recycled packaging and polybags when you ship our goods?
items.answer: We offer industrially compostable and reusable bags. Our corn-starch bags compost in industrial composting facilities, not in home compost or landfill. Our eco zip-lock bags are the reusable option, not for compost. Which claim applies depends on how your customers can dispose of the bag. We supply material supplier data for both bags. That data covers only the bag material, not the printed finished pack. You need to check any claim about disposing of the whole pack against your market's rules. We only print wording that you've approved in writing.

items.question: Do you subcontract any sewing or printing, and are those workshops held to the same standards as your own factory?
items.answer: No. We do [all sewing, printing and other production in our own factory](/about-us/), and no production stage goes to an outside workshop. Freight and third-party lab tests run through our partners.

seo.description: Clear rules for every order: read Strandmill's Terms and Conditions on samples, order confirmations, shipping, returns, refunds and claims.

hero.heading: Terms and Conditions for Working With Strandmill

cta.label: Contact us

blocks.heading: Who We Are and Variances on Stock Styles
paragraphs: We make all of our swimwear ourselves, in our one factory in Guangzhou, Guangdong, China. Stock styles can vary slightly in size, construction, colour or shade from item to item.

As a [factory-owned B2B business](/about-us/), we keep production and export within one company, so quality, cost and delivery stay under our direct control. We sell only through our website and our team. There's no online shop or third-party marketplace store, and you agree every order directly with us.

blocks.heading: Quality Claims, Returns and Outside Vendor Liability
paragraphs: When you inspect your goods and send us evidence for specific cartons, we can trace a quality problem and work out a remedy without the goods being shipped back.

items.heading: Inspect on arrival
items.text: As soon as your goods arrive, inspect a sample from each carton before any decoration or relabelling. This inspection is your responsibility.

items.heading: Report within seven days
items.text: Report any quality problem within 7 days of receipt. Include photos or videos that show the defect, the carton markings and the labels.

items.heading: Assessment and remedy
items.text: We use your evidence to trace the production lot and assess the cause. Then we repair, remake or replace the pieces, or credit you their cost.

items.heading: Shipping costs remain payable
items.text: We don't refund shipping and handling charges, and you pay the courier and shipping charges for any replacement pieces.

items.heading: Written return authorisation
items.text: Get our written return authorisation number before you return anything. We refuse any package or carton that doesn't show it.

items.heading: Authorised return charges
items.text: An authorised return carries a 20% restocking fee, and we bill return freight separately on top of that fee.

items.heading: Excluded goods and samples
items.text: Samples can't be returned. Neither can goods altered by screen printing, embroidery, relabelling, washing, dyeing, embellishment or any other means.

items.heading: Outside vendor liability
items.text: We aren't liable for work done by third parties or outside vendors, and our quality remedies don't cover defects caused by that work.

blocks.heading: Samples, Order Confirmations, Shipping and Refunds
paragraphs: We quote before we make any samples, and sample-related fees stay separate from your bulk order.

items.heading: Price agreement first
items.text: We agree the price with you through our [quotation process](/request-a-quote/) before we move on to making your sample.

items.heading: Sample development
items.text: Our [development process](/development/) turns your brief or tech pack into a standard sample in 10 to 15 days. You approve its quality before bulk production and full final inspection.

items.heading: Sample and design fees
items.text: Each sample costs USD 50. The design fee is USD 50 per design and covers its pattern or print and all its colourways.

items.heading: No fee credits
items.text: We don't refund sample and design fees, and we don't credit them against your bulk order.

items.heading: Sample courier charge
items.text: Courier delivery of samples costs you USD 50, on top of the sample fee.

items.heading: Enquiry response time
items.text: When you [contact our team](/contact-us/), we reply to every enquiry within one business day.

lead: We price your range from your own designs, quantities and sizes, not from a generic list.

cta.label: Prefer email? Contact us

blocks.heading: Target Dates, Rush Orders and Realistic Timing
paragraphs: We check your required delivery date against our timelines, which are 10 to 15 days for sampling and 35 to 40 days for bulk production. Then we put realistic timing on your swimwear quotation sheet. You don't need a target date to ask for pricing. If your deadline is tighter, we offer rush production when our schedule allows it. We quote the rush surcharge as a percentage of the order value, and you pay the full surcharge with your 50% deposit.
