blocks.heading: Minimum Order Quantities, Trial Runs and Lead Times

items.heading: Minimum order quantity
items.text: You can start at 50 pieces per style in each colour, which works well for small and growing labels.

items.heading: First trial run
items.text: We agree your first trial run with you case by case. How flexible we can be on quantity depends on what production allows.

items.heading: Bulk production start
items.text: Bulk production starts once you've approved the sample and we've received your deposit. Your order size and the season set the production timing.

blocks.heading: What to Send for a Free, Accurate Quotation
paragraphs: Please send a complete brief: missing details mean follow-up questions or assumptions in the quotation, which delays our reply.

steps.heading: Send your style details
steps.text: Send us your tech pack or design, along with your preferred fabrics, colours, prints, size chart, quantity per colourway and packing needs. This lets us check whether your swimwear can be made.

steps.heading: Choose your format
steps.text: If you don't have a tech pack, send front and back screenshots or clear line drawings marked with style codes, fabrics and colours. You can send your brief by email or WhatsApp.

steps.heading: Receive your free quotation
steps.text: Once we have complete design information, we prepare your free quotation sheet within 2 to 3 working days. It estimates price and timing for sampling, fabrics, accessories, branding, labelling, production and shipping.

steps.heading: Check service response times
steps.text: For logo work such as screen printing, embroidery or labels, we answer within one business day. Cut-and-sew swimwear or sublimation quotes take 2 to 3 working days. Multi-colourway styles get a quotation per colourway.

steps.heading: Review the details together
steps.text: We set up a phone call with you to go through products, artwork, sizing, quantities, pricing and minimums, and to settle anything your first brief left open.

steps.heading: Confirm before you order
steps.text: You confirm quantities, colours and customisation. We confirm availability, lead times and every other detail before you place your order. Once you agree to the quoted price, we start making your sample.

blocks.heading: Sample Fees, Payment Terms and Shipping Options
paragraphs: We confirm components and consumption before we commit to a bulk cost. Before sourcing, any price is an estimate, and specialty trims can make sourcing take longer.

items.heading: Component selection
items.text: Choosing the fabrics, ribbons, hardware and tags for your style takes about a week. With some suppliers it takes longer.

items.heading: Material consumption and costing
items.text: We work out the components each piece needs and the total across your bulk order. We then use those figures and component availability to estimate your bulk production and total product costs.

items.heading: Sample and design fees

items.question: How long is the quoted price valid, and can it change before bulk production?

If you change that specification later, we reopen the price. After 30 days, we recheck current fabric and trim costs and send you an updated quotation.

seo.title: Swimwear Accessories Manufacturer: Cups & Hats | Strandmill
seo.description: Swimwear accessories manufacturer for foam cups, underwires, straps, beads, rhinestones, bucket hats and hair accessories, made to your specs in Guangzhou.

hero.heading: Swimwear Accessories Manufacturer for Cups, Straps, Beads and Hats
lead: Our product specialists weigh cost, durability and appearance for each cup, strap, bead and hat you choose.

cta.label: Request a quote for swimwear accessories

blocks.heading: OEM Swimwear Accessories from Your Tech Pack, Sample or Sketch
paragraphs: Send us a tech pack, CAD file, physical sample, sketch or visual reference, and we develop your swimwear accessories from it. If all you have so far is your brand goals, we build the brief around your target market, positioning and pricing tier. Our product specialists then recommend options that balance cost, durability and appearance against your concept and your target price.

blocks.heading: Wholesale Accessory Minimums, Trial Runs and Payment Terms

items.heading: Standalone orders
items.text: You can order accessories without ordering swimwear. Minimums start at 50 pieces per style in each colour, and that includes finished bucket hats and scrunchies.

items.heading: Focused first range
items.text: Your first range starts with a few core styles in your best-selling colours. More colours come once sell-through has proven them.

items.heading: Trial quantities
items.text: We agree your first trial quantities case by case. Our flexibility is limited by what production allows.

items.heading: Payment terms
items.text: You pay a 50% deposit when you confirm the order and the remaining 50% before shipment.

blocks.heading: Our Accessories Factory in Guangzhou, China
paragraphs: We make swimwear and finished accessories ourselves in our one factory in Guangzhou, Guangdong, China.

items.heading: Production standards
paragraphs: Our production holds [OEKO-TEX Standard 100, GRS, RCS, bluesign, ISO 9001 and WRAP](/sustainability/) certification.

items.heading: Direct factory control
paragraphs: With our [factory ownership](/about-us/), production and export stay inside one company, so we have direct control over your quality, cost and delivery.

items.heading: In-house development
paragraphs: Our [design team](/development/) does pattern design, grading and fit development in-house, so you go through fewer rounds of design back-and-forth.

items.heading: Contact our team
paragraphs: [Contact us](/contact-us/) by email, WhatsApp or our website form. We reply within one business day.

blocks.heading: Sample Fees, Lead Times and Production Timeline

steps.heading: Brief and fees
steps.text: You send us your brief or tech pack. Each sample costs USD 50, plus USD 50 per design for its pattern or print, which covers all colourways. Neither fee is refunded or credited.

steps.heading: Sample review
steps.text: Your standard sample is ready in 10 to 15 days, and you review it before you approve bulk production.

steps.heading: Bulk production
steps.text: Once you approve the sample and we receive your deposit, bulk production takes 35 to 40 days, depending on order size and season.

steps.heading: Final inspection
steps.text: We do a full final inspection, and then your completed order goes to shipment under the shipping terms you agreed.

blocks.heading: Shipping Terms: FOB, CIF and DDP

items.heading: Shipping options
items.text: We ship FOB, CIF or DDP. With worldwide DDP, you get one all-in price for delivery to your door, and we handle freight, customs and duties through our forwarding partners.

items.heading: Detailed quotation
items.text: Once we have your complete design information, meaning front-and-back images, tech packs or clear drawings, we send your [quotation](/request-a-quote/) within 2 to 3 working days. It covers everything from sampling through production to shipping.

items.heading: Reporting deadline
items.text: Under our [order terms](/terms-and-conditions/), you have 7 days from receiving your goods to report any shortages, defects, late-delivery damages or returns to us in writing.

blocks.heading: Private Label Woven, Satin and Size Labels

items.heading: Brand and care labels
paragraphs: Woven brand labels, soft satin care labels and size labels for your accessories come through our [Swimwear Packaging & Custom Brand Labels](/swimwear-packaging-custom-brand-labels/) service, with the label types set out there.

items.heading: Additional personalisation
paragraphs: To carry your brand beyond the woven label, you can personalise accessories with [embroidery](/swimwear-embroidery/), custom labels or branded packaging.

blocks.heading: Custom Metal Hardware, Charms and Finishes

items.heading: Exposure and finish
items.text: We pick the base metal and plating to stand up to chlorine and salt water. Charms electroplated by our hardware suppliers keep their bright finish after saltwater and sun.

items.heading: Hardware range
items.text: Our [Swimwear Hardware](/swimwear-hardware/) range covers metal rings, sliders, buckles and hooks in gold, silver, rose gold or gunmetal, and moulded plastic parts in black, white, clear or Pantone-dyed colours.

items.heading: Hardware ordering
items.text: You can have our Swimwear Hardware supplied as part of garment production, or you can buy it separately at its applicable minimum quantities.

blocks.heading: Rhinestones, Crystals and Beads for Swimwear

items.heading: Decoration choices
paragraphs: We offer heat-press and sew-on rhinestones and crystals in a range of sizes, colours and patterns. We also offer acrylic, resin, metal and wood beads, including custom-moulded designs matched to your colours.

items.heading: Swim-ready materials
paragraphs: Stainless steel or plated brass beads, resin and acrylic beads, and glass crystals sewn into metal claw settings all hold up to repeated pool and sea use.

items.heading: Shore-only materials
paragraphs: Wood beads, shell pieces and heat-press rhinestones go only on shore-only accessories such as hats and bags; on garments, we sew every stone on by hand. On your trim sheet, we mark every option as swim-ready or shore-only.

items.heading: Stretch-safe placement
paragraphs: We keep dense decoration away from side seams, cup edges and leg openings. We sew small clusters at least 3 mm apart, so the fabric around them still stretches by about 30%.

items.heading: Protected skin contact
paragraphs: We stitch each decoration through soft backing and cover knots and thread ends with the lining. That way nothing rubs the skin or snags nearby fabric.

items.heading: Material cost drivers
paragraphs: Your price is set by complexity, materials, decoration count and order quantity. Glass crystals and metal beads cost more than acrylic or resin, and every extra stone adds material and handwork.

items.heading: Labour cost drivers
paragraphs: Hand sewing takes longer than heat-pressing. Decoration over seams, cups or curves also takes more labour than decoration on flat panels.

blocks.heading: Straps and Strings Made to Your Specs
paragraphs: You choose the width, stretch, colour and texture of our straps and strings. We then match the construction to the load each one carries: firmer flat or braided straps handle support, and softer ruched or tube straps are mainly decorative.

visuals.purpose: Shows which strap constructions suit load-bearing use and which suit decorative use.
visuals.caption: Choosing strap construction by load

blocks.heading: Cups, Underwires, Boning and Silicone Grip
paragraphs: We match your cups, wires or boning and grip tape so they work together as one support system for your style.
rows: Our soft, quick-drying foam cups come in triangle, round and push-up shapes, and you can have them removable or sewn in.
3 mm foam adds almost no bulk.
Moulded cups of 5 to 8 mm give natural shaping.
Graduated push-up cups are 5 mm at the top edge and 15 mm at the base.
Our nylon-coated stainless steel wires run from size 30 to 46 and cover cup sizes up to G.
Plastic wires are the lighter option for small cups and bandeau styles.
The wire ends are capped and sit in padded, double-layer nylon channelling that we stitch closed at both ends, so the wires don't break through or rust in chlorine or salt water.
For bandeau and strapless support, we insert plastic or rubber boning into the side seams or bodice.

Transparent elastic tape stops slipping inside waistbands, chest lines and leg openings. It comes in 6, 10, 15 and 20 mm widths, with full-width silicone, single-stripe, double-stripe, dot or wave patterns.
To hold without leaving pressure marks, we use 10 mm striped tape at chest lines, 15 to 20 mm dot tape at waistbands and 6 to 10 mm wave or dot tape at leg openings.

blocks.heading: Hygienic Liners Printed with Your Logo
paragraphs: Our trim suppliers make your hygienic liners from skin-friendly adhesive materials in a range of shapes and colours, and we match the shape and adhesive to your gusset and fabric. We keep your logo or brand message simple and easy to read. Branded liners need an order above 3,000 units. Liners peel off cleanly for up to 12 months in normal storage, and sampling includes an 8-hour wear peel-test.

blocks.heading: Eco Packaging Printed With Your Logo

items.heading: Your packaging design
paragraphs: We customise every eco packaging option with your logo and layout. We keep the artwork simple and use only a few print colours, so the packaging looks the same from order to order.

items.heading: Branded bag minimums
paragraphs: Print minimums and screen fees for logo bags are set out on our [Swimwear Packaging & Custom Brand Labels](/swimwear-packaging-custom-brand-labels/) service page.

items.heading: Wet and dry uses
paragraphs: For damp suits, we offer ventilated cotton mesh bags and wet/dry bags that are water-resistant but not leakproof. Cotton drawstring, corn-starch and eco zip-lock bags are for dry presentation and shipping.

blocks.heading: Bucket Hats, Hair and Beach Accessories

items.heading: Finished accessory range
paragraphs: We make waterproof bucket hats and swimming scrunchies in durable fabrics with reinforced stitching. We also make hair elastics and adjustable headbands.

items.heading: Hat design choices
paragraphs: Our straw, camo and floral bucket hats come with adjustable chin straps. You can also choose wide-brim, crochet, sports, summer and XXXL designs.

items.heading: Waterproof hat construction
paragraphs: Your waterproof bucket hats have polyester or nylon shells with PU-coated backs and taped seams, so water stays out.

items.heading: Sun protection rating
paragraphs: Hats made with our UPF 50+ fabrics come with AS/NZS 4399 test documentation. The rating applies only to dry, relaxed fabric.

items.heading: Head size coverage
paragraphs: Children's sizes run from 48 to 54 cm, standard adult sizes from 56 to 60 cm and XXXL from 62 to 64 cm. Chin straps or inner drawcords fine-tune the fit.

items.heading: Repeated swimming use
paragraphs: Hats in nylon, polyester and spandex blends, with taped or overlocked seams and soft, unstiffened brims, stand up to repeated pool and sea use when they're rinsed in fresh water and dried afterwards.

items.heading: Shore-only hat care
paragraphs: Natural straw and crochet hats are for the shore only, because soaking weakens their fibres and pulls the crowns out of shape. Each hat's care label matches how it's meant to be used.

blocks.heading: Quality Control and Material Safety Testing

items.heading: Colour approval
items.text: We check your accessories against swatches from the actual production fabric lot under the same light. We pay particular attention to custom-dyed parts.

items.heading: Finish and fit
items.text: We check that matte, glossy and brushed surfaces are even. Then we test each accessory on its own and fitted to the garment, and check colour and finish again.

items.heading: Children's safety figures
items.text: For [children's swimwear](/children-s-swimwear-manufacturer/), trims pass 90 N pull tests, pieces for under-3s carry no removable decorations, and metals pass EN 1811 and CPSIA limits: 100 ppm for base metal and 90 ppm for coatings.

blocks.heading: Related products and services
Frequently Asked Questions

items.question: Can you provide a silicone-free grip solution for customers who cannot wear silicone tape?
items.answer: Yes. We use a textured polyurethane grip print, ribbed or plush-back elastic, or an edge band cut 1 to 2 cm shorter so its tension holds the garment in place. Before bulk production, we sample the option you choose on your style so you can approve the hold.

items.question: Can you supply latex-free elastic components for accessories intended for latex-sensitive customers?
items.answer: Yes. For straps, scrunchies, hair elastics and headbands, we use spandex-covered or clear TPU elastic in place of rubber thread. We mark these components as latex-free on your trim sheet and keep them stored separately during production.

items.question: For children's bucket hats, can you provide breakaway chin straps or strap-free constructions to reduce entanglement risk?
items.answer: Yes. We fit plastic safety clips that release under about 25 to 45 N. Or we leave the strap off and use an elasticated inner band with an adjustable toggle behind the crown.

items.question: What usually goes wrong with swimwear accessories, how do you prevent it, and what care instructions should I give my customers?
items.answer: The main failures are tarnished plating, rust marks, loose stones or beads, and elastic or grip tape that goes slack. Before you sign off bulk, we lacquer plated hardware and soak-test it in salt water for 24 hours, pull-test sewn and heat-pressed stones, and stretch-test elastics and grip tape. Your hangtag or care label tells customers to rinse in cool fresh water after every swim, hand wash with mild soap, dry flat in the shade, and keep away from hot tubs, sunscreen oils and tumble dryers.

items.question: What bead sizes and bore diameters can you supply to fit my swimwear cords?
items.answer: We supply beads from 6 mm to 20 mm across, with bore diameters from 2 mm to 5 mm in 2, 3, 4 or 5 mm options. They fit cords from 1.5 mm to 4.5 mm thick. Send us a 20 cm sample of your cord and we match the bore so the beads slide with light friction and stay where you put them.

items.question: Which accessory choices raise or lower the cost per piece, so I can balance looks against my target price?
items.answer: Resin or plastic costs less than metal. Stock hardware and beads cost less than custom-moulded parts, and those add a one-off mould fee. Standard gold or silver plating costs less than rose gold, gunmetal or matte black. Heat-press decoration is quicker and cheaper than hand-sewn stones, but it goes on shore-only pieces. Plain liners and packaging cost less than printed ones.

seo.title: Plus-Size Swimwear Manufacturer up to 5XL | Strandmill
seo.description: OEM/ODM plus-size swimsuits built to your brief by a plus-size swimwear manufacturer: bust and tummy support, quality-checked trims and private label.

hero.heading: Plus-Size Swimwear Manufacturer for Supportive, Private-Label Styles
lead: Contoured seams shape the silhouette, so support is built into the pattern of every swimsuit.

cta.label: Request a quote for plus size swimwear

blocks.heading: OEM and ODM Plus-Size Swimsuits Shaped to Your Design Brief
paragraphs: We make your women’s plus-size swimwear under OEM or ODM, so your bikinis, one-piece swimsuits and matching sets all come from one source. Contoured seams shape the silhouette. We let you pick the silhouette for every swimsuit, whether that's strapless, halter, sleeveless or cut-out, matched to your design brief.

blocks.heading: Wholesale Plus-Size Tankinis, Swim Dresses and 50-Piece Minimums

items.heading: Longline tankinis
paragraphs: We make tankinis that reach past the hip, with ruched sides, empire waists, halter or cross-back straps, and loose babydoll or swing shapes.

items.heading: Mix-and-match bottoms
paragraphs: You can pair tops with classic or high-waisted briefs, boy-shorts, swim shorts or swim skirts, so your customers choose coverage for bust, tummy and thighs separately.

items.heading: Fuller coverage
paragraphs: We also make swim dresses and modest one-pieces, which give you fuller-coverage options next to the separates in your range.

items.heading: Stock commitments
paragraphs: Every extra separate adds styles and sizes you have to stock. If your budget is small, start with a few key tankini-and-bottom pairings to keep the range focused.

items.heading: Minimum order
paragraphs: Orders start at 50 pieces per style in each colour. For first trials, we agree quantities with you case by case within production limits.

blocks.heading: China Factory Terms: Samples, Lead Times, Payment and Shipping
paragraphs: We make swimwear in our own factory, our only one, in Guangzhou, Guangdong, China.

items.heading: Sample terms
paragraphs: A standard sample takes 10 to 15 days and costs USD 50. Design fees are USD 50 per pattern or print and cover all colourways. We don't refund or credit either fee.

items.heading: Production and payment
paragraphs: Once you approve the sample and we receive your 50% confirmation deposit, bulk production takes 35 to 40 days, depending on order size and season. A full final inspection follows, and the remaining 50% is due before shipment.

items.heading: Shipping terms
paragraphs: We ship on FOB, CIF or DDP terms. With worldwide DDP, we handle door delivery, duties, customs and freight through our forwarding partners for one all-in price.

items.heading: Delivery and packing
paragraphs: Under our [sample delivery and packing terms](/faq/), courier cost adds USD 50. You can mix sizes and colours, mixed-ratio cartons are free, and for larger sizes we recommend 4 each of L, XL and 2XL per carton.

items.heading: Quote before sampling
paragraphs: Through our [quotation process](/request-a-quote/), we agree the price with you before we start making your sample.

items.heading: Enquiry response
paragraphs: When you [contact our team](/contact-us/), you'll get a reply within one business day. We answer every enquiry, so you know when to expect to hear from us.

items.heading: Factory ownership
paragraphs: We've run our [factory and export business](/about-us/) since 2011. That keeps quality, cost and delivery under our direct control, and you agree orders directly with our team.

items.heading: Production credentials
paragraphs: Our [production credentials](/sustainability/) are OEKO-TEX Standard 100 for tested fabrics and trims, GRS and RCS for recycled fabrics, bluesign for chemistry, ISO 9001 for quality management and WRAP for social compliance.

blocks.heading: Bust, Tummy and Waistband Support That Stays in Place
paragraphs: We match each support feature to its job, solving digging straps, rolling waistbands and riding leg openings at the pattern stage, without stacking every feature onto one suit.

items.heading: Straps and bands
items.text: For plus-size and extended-cup ranges, we reposition and widen adjustable straps, widen back bands, reinforce the underbust elastic and build in bust support.

items.heading: Cup options
items.text: Structured underwire tops run from D through DD+ up to a G cup. Moulded cups come in A to DD.

items.heading: Cup-sized construction
items.text: If you ask, we add underwire channels and grade to your size chart. Cup-sized underwire gives the best support, but every band-and-cup combination counts as its own size.

items.heading: Removable padding
items.text: Our bikinis and one-piece sets come with removable padding, so the wearer can adjust coverage and shaping herself.

items.heading: Firm tummy control
items.text: Where your design needs firm control, a separate power mesh front panel anchored into the side seams provides it.

items.heading: Light front smoothing
items.text: A double front lining gives light smoothing and opacity without the compression of a shaping construction.

items.heading: Strongest shaping
items.text: We cut the front body or the whole suit in compression swim fabric, and add an extra power mesh panel if you specify one.

items.heading: Secure waistbands
items.text: Our waistbands are 3 to 4 cm wide, with fully enclosed rubber elastic stitched through every layer. Where it's needed, we add a high-waisted cut or a side-seam bone.

blocks.heading: Heavier Fabrics, Full Front Linings and Power Mesh

items.heading: Heavier base fabric
paragraphs: For larger sizes we specify about 200 to 220 gsm, in 80% nylon 20% spandex or a higher-spandex blend. It holds its shape better and stays more opaque under larger-size stretch than our standard 180–200 GSM fabric.

items.heading: Lining and trade-offs
paragraphs: Full front linings are 140 gsm nylon-spandex, and we add power mesh only where you need extra hold. Heavier fabric and full linings cost more and dry more slowly, so they work against very lightweight or resort briefs.

items.heading: Specialist fabric sourcing
paragraphs: Our [fabric sourcing](/swimwear-fabrics-sourcing/) covers nylon and polyester blended with spandex. On request, you can also have chlorine-resistant LYCRA Xtra Life, ECONYL recycled nylon, REPREVE recycled polyester and Italian Carvico.

items.heading: Hardware performance
paragraphs: Our [Swimwear Hardware service](/swimwear-hardware/) supplies elastics and straps from 3 mm to 25 mm wide. They recover 95% or more of their stretch after 100 cycles and withstand more than 200 hours of chlorine exposure.

blocks.heading: Your Designs, Size-by-Size Print Placement and Private Label Branding
paragraphs: We help you choose designs that suit plus-size customers, and we apply your private label. We place and approve your artwork size by size, so focal motifs stay in the right position as bust and abdomen panels grow. We don't just scale up the base-size artwork.

Size-by-size placement adds artwork time and an approval round. All-over prints that need no placement move faster. Our [custom printing](/custom-swimwear-printing/) includes leopard and floral motifs for one-piece swimsuits.

items.detail: You approve the digital placement for each size.

items.label: Print bulk fabric
items.detail: Bulk fabric is printed only after every size's placement is approved.

blocks.heading: Ready-to-Brand Curvy Collections and Low-MOQ Trend Drops

items.heading: Test market demand
paragraphs: Our low-MOQ, ready-to-brand trend drops let you test what sells in your market before you commit to larger orders and to full-custom pattern and sampling costs.

items.heading: Know the trade-off
paragraphs: Ready-to-brand styles aren't exclusive to your label, and they give you less control over fit and fabric than custom development does.

blocks.heading: What buyers say

items.quote: The underwire tops held up well, and the team reinforced the straps, side seams and bands where our customers need the most support. They paid close attention to every fit comment we sent.

Frequently Asked Questions

items.question: Can you take our current straight-size styles and extend them into plus sizes with adjusted fit and support?
items.answer: Yes. We extend your styles up to 5XL by redrafting each one on a 2XL base, regrading it and adjusting the support. That means we reposition straps, widen back bands, reinforce the underbust elastic and add built-in bust support. We sample each extended style in 10 to 15 days, and you approve the fit before bulk production starts.

items.question: What makes a plus-size style cost more than a standard-size style, such as extra fabric, underwires, shaping linings or extra sizes?
items.answer: Larger sizes use more fabric. Underwires, moulded or cup-sized construction, power mesh and shaping linings add materials and sewing time. Dedicated base patterns, fit sessions and extra graded sizes add development time and cost. With band-and-cup sizing, every combination counts as its own size.

items.question: How do you verify that bust support and coverage remain secure when a plus-size suit is wet and the wearer swims or bends?
items.answer: We check the sample against your measurement sheet on a real 2XL fit model, then wet-test it before grading. She swims, bends and lifts her arms for at least 30 minutes while we check support, stretch, coverage and opacity. Finished-measurement tolerances are -0.5 to 0.5 cm for straps and bindings and -1 to 1 cm for body measurements.

items.question: Do you build plus-size patterns from a dedicated plus-size base size, or simply grade up a regular-size pattern?
items.answer: We start from a dedicated 2XL base pattern fitted on a 2XL model and grade up to 5XL from there. We don't just enlarge a straight-size pattern. Bust, waist and hip grading steps are 5 cm per size, against 4 cm in straight sizes. Extra length in the rise, straps and back band keeps the coverage as body proportions change.

seo.description: Get matched men's and women's sets from a couples matching swimsuit manufacturer: prints matched across fabrics, colour-drift checks and in-house QC.

hero.heading: Couples Matching Swimsuit Manufacturer for His-and-Hers Lines
lead: Order the women's and men's pieces in different quantities to suit how each side sells.

cta.label: Request a quote for couples matching swimsuits

blocks.heading: Private Label Matching Sets for Couples
paragraphs: You can order different quantities of the women's and men's pieces in our couples matching swimsuits, as long as each style reaches 50 pieces per colour. We make these coordinated sets under your brand. Each style comes in 3 to 4 sizes. The standard S:M:L:XL ratio is 1:2:2:1. You can also set different size ratios for the men's and women's styles.

visuals.purpose: Shows the usual way an order of each style is split across sizes, which the buyer can set separately for the men's and women's pieces.

blocks.heading: Matching Cover-Ups, Resort Shirts and Order Minimums

items.heading: Coordinating pieces
items.text: We carry your set's print onto sarongs, kimonos, beach dresses and men's short-sleeve resort shirts. We print and sew them in our factory alongside your swimwear.

items.heading: Shared production run
items.text: If you start with one or two coordinating pieces printed from the same artwork in the same production window, colour and scale stay consistent across the swimwear and the lighter fabrics.

items.heading: Separate style minimums
items.text: Each added item starts at 50 pieces per colour, so a wider capsule ties up more stock and budget than swimwear alone.

items.heading: First trial orders
items.text: We agree quantities for a first trial order case by case. How flexible we can be depends on what production allows.

blocks.heading: Our Own Swimsuit Factory in China
paragraphs: We make your swimwear in our own factory in Guangzhou, Guangdong, China. It's a single factory, and our company owns it. Our [factory and export operation](/about-us/) are part of the same company, so we control quality, cost and delivery directly. We check your goods throughout production and again before shipment. Our [production certifications](/sustainability/) include OEKO-TEX Standard 100 for tested fabrics and trims, GRS and RCS for recycled fabrics, bluesign for chemistry, ISO 9001 for quality management and WRAP for social compliance.

blocks.heading: Get Your Matching Swimsuit Quote and Sample

items.heading: Design information
items.text: Send us front and back images, tech packs or clear line drawings, and we'll base your quotation on them.

items.heading: Detailed quotation
items.text: Once your design information is complete, you get your [quotation](/request-a-quote/) within 2 to 3 working days. It covers sampling, fabrics, accessories, branding, labelling, production and shipping.

items.heading: Standard samples
items.text: We make a standard sample in 10 to 15 days so you can review it before you approve bulk production.

items.heading: Sample and design fees
items.text: Each sample costs USD 50. Each design also costs USD 50, which covers its pattern or print and all of its colourways. Neither fee is refunded or credited.

items.heading: Enquiry response
items.text: We reply to every [enquiry](/contact-us/) within one business day. Once your design information is complete, we prepare your detailed quotation.

blocks.heading: Bulk Lead Times, Payment Terms and Shipping Options

items.heading: Bulk production timing
items.text: Once you've approved the sample and we've received your deposit, bulk production takes 35 to 40 days. Your order size and the season decide where in that range it falls.

items.heading: Payment schedule
items.text: You pay a 50% deposit when you confirm the order and the other 50% before shipment.

items.heading: Shipping terms
items.text: We ship FOB, CIF or DDP. With worldwide DDP, you get one all-in price for delivery to your door, and we handle duties, customs and freight through our forwarding partners.

items.heading: Sample courier charge
items.text: Under our [sample delivery terms](/faq/), you pay a USD 50 courier charge on top of the sample fee.

blocks.heading: Design Support and Colour-Matched Fabrics for Each Set

items.heading: Design starting points
paragraphs: With our [OEM and ODM development](/development/), you can start a new couples style from your own design, a picture or an idea.

items.heading: Fabric and colour decisions
paragraphs: Our design specialists develop the line with you. They settle the fabrics and colour for both styles before sampling, so the two pieces hold the same colour.

items.heading: Paired sample approval
paragraphs: We always approve the two samples together, never one at a time, and we check sizing, fit, proportion and shade. If you change one piece and its partner then needs checking again against it, that adds a sampling round.

items.heading: Fabric sourcing options
paragraphs: Our [fabric sourcing](/swimwear-fabrics-sourcing/) covers nylon and polyester blended with spandex, including 80% nylon 20% spandex, plus matching linings. If you ask, we also supply chlorine-resistant LYCRA Xtra Life, recycled ECONYL nylon, recycled REPREVE polyester and Italian Carvico fabrics.

blocks.heading: Custom Prints Matched Across Different Fabrics
paragraphs: If your set uses different fabrics, your print goes through four steps: a digital preview, shared artwork, separate colour matching for each fabric, and a physical review of the two pieces together. A screen can't show how each fabric base takes the print. Approving the preview settles scale and placement, but it doesn't give you reliable colour agreement. Waiting for physical samples takes longer than approving on screen alone, but it avoids colour surprises in production. Our [Custom Printing service](/custom-swimwear-printing/) uses water-based digital printing with calibrated colour. That gives you sharp, high-resolution artwork, less deviation on stretch fabric and consistent colour from one run to the next.

items.detail: You receive a preview of the print on each fabric, showing colour matching, motif scale and placement on both garments, and approve scale and placement from it.

items.detail: Both pieces are printed from the same artwork file at the same scale.

items.label: Colour-match each fabric
items.detail: Colour is matched on each fabric separately.

items.label: Compare physical samples
items.detail: The two pieces are compared side by side on the samples for every set, where colour match is judged.

blocks.heading: Keeping Colour Consistent Between His and Hers Pieces
paragraphs: Different dye lots are the most common reason his and hers pieces look mismatched under shop lighting. We plan a single dye lot to cover both pieces for your whole order, which removes that cause, and we check the pair together at final inspection. If you reorder the matching pieces together, the restock stays coordinated. If a later reorder needs a new dye lot, it has to be colour-matched against your earlier stock. To keep the pair matched after wear, we use the same fabric base and print method for both pieces, and you can choose the chlorine-resistant fabric option for both garments.

Frequently Asked Questions

items.question: Which women's and men's styles can be paired into one couples matching set?
items.answer: Any [women's style](/women-s-swimwear-manufacturer/) we make can go with [men's](/men-s-swimwear-manufacturer/) swim trunks, board shorts or swim briefs in the same print or colour story. That includes triangle and bandeau bikinis, one-pieces and tankinis. One print also works for more than one pairing, so you could match a bikini and a one-piece to the same trunks.

items.question: Do you have ready-made couples matching designs we can brand or buy wholesale, or does every set have to be custom developed?
items.answer: You don't have to develop every set from scratch. We hold some styles for wholesale, so ask us which couples designs are available right now. Our ready-made designs stay open to every buyer, but your prints, artwork and branding are used only for you. Any custom or ODM couples set we develop for your brand is exclusive to you.

items.question: How does positioning coordinated motifs on both garments affect fabric use and cutting cost compared with sharing an all-over repeat print?
items.answer: Placed coordinated motifs use about 10 to 15% more fabric than an all-over repeat, because every panel has to line up with the print. Each piece takes longer to cut and costs more. The artwork has to be made for each size, and we charge physical approval strike-offs separately for each motif. An all-over repeat covers both pieces, nests tightly with the least waste and makes size grading simpler, so it's the easier choice for a first collection. If you keep placed motifs for a few hero sets, you limit the extra work and still get the deliberate, mirrored placement an all-over repeat can't give you.
